source: Dylan's Meal Planner (July 2026): 3,810 breakfast, lunch, dinner and snack recipes. Desserts and 50 recipes whose calories differ from 4/4/9 × their protein, carbohydrate and fat by more than 15% are left out. Store prices come from the app.

recipes.name: Veggie Biscuit Breakfast Bake with Pepper Jack
steps: Brown the protein with onion and pepper.
Layer the base and filling in a greased 9x13 dish.
Whisk eggs with milk and cheese; pour over.
Bake at 375°F until puffed and set, 40–45 minutes.

recipes.name: Ham, Egg & Pepper Jack Bagel Sandwiches
steps: Toast the bread and cook the protein.
Fry or scramble the eggs in butter.
Layer protein, egg, and cheese; melt briefly.
Assemble and serve hot.

batch.notes: Pack the parts separately; assemble when you eat.

recipes.name: Bacon Breakfast Tacos (Spicy)
steps: Cook the filling protein; scramble in the eggs.
Warm tortillas; layer eggs, filling, and cheese.
Add toppings, roll or fold, and toast seam-side down.
Serve with extra salsa.

recipes.name: Strawberries & Cream Chia Pudding (Coconut Milk)
steps: Whisk chia with milk, honey, and vanilla.
Whisk again after 10 minutes; refrigerate overnight.
Stir and top with mix-ins.
Serve chilled.

batch.notes: Fridge only, 3 days; mix the Thu–Fri jars on Wednesday.

recipes.name: Ham & Swiss Crepes (Whole-Wheat)
steps: Blend a thin batter; rest 10 minutes.
Swirl batter in a buttered nonstick pan; cook 1–2 minutes per side.
Fill and fold each crepe.
Serve warm.

recipes.name: Classic Diner Eggs, Bacon & Home Fries
steps: Cook the potatoes or grits first.
Cook the protein until browned.
Cook the eggs to order in butter.
Plate everything together and season.

recipes.name: Coconut-Crusted Sourdough French Toast
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, vanilla, and cinnamon into a custard.
Soak bread slices briefly on both sides.
Griddle in butter until golden on both sides.
Finish with toppings and maple syrup.

batch.notes: The coating softens in storage; re-crisp in the oven or an air fryer.

recipes.name: Sausage Mushroom & Onion Frittata with Cheddar
steps: Whisk eggs and cream; season well.
Sauté fillings in an oven-safe skillet.
Pour in eggs, scatter cheese, and cook 2 minutes on the stove.
Bake at 400°F until just set, 12–15 minutes.

batch.notes: Reheat to 165 °F; eggs turn rubbery if frozen.

recipes.name: Ham & Hash Brown Breakfast Hash with Spinach & Tomato
steps: Crisp the potatoes in oil in a large skillet.
Add the protein and vegetables; cook until browned.
Make wells and crack in the eggs; cover until set.
Season with smoked paprika and serve from the pan.

recipes.name: Classic Shakshuka
steps: Prep and cook the components as the dish requires.
Build the dish in one pan or bowl where possible.
Taste, season, and garnish.
Serve hot and fresh.

batch.notes: Reheat to 165 °F; eggs turn rubbery if frozen.

recipes.name: Peach Bakery-Style Muffins with Streusel
steps: Whisk dry and wet ingredients separately, then combine.
Fold in the flavor mix-ins without overmixing.
Portion into the pan and add topping if using.
Bake until a tester comes out clean; cool briefly.

recipes.name: Cinnamon-Raisin Steel-Cut Oats
steps: Combine oats, milk, and a pinch of salt.
Cook (or bake) until creamy and tender.
Stir in the flavor mix-ins.
Portion and serve warm.

recipes.name: Turkey, Mushroom & Onion & Pepper Jack Omelet
steps: Whisk eggs with milk, salt, and pepper.
Sauté the fillings in butter until tender; set aside.
Pour eggs into the pan; when nearly set, add fillings and cheese.
Fold, rest 1 minute, and serve.

batch.notes: Reheat to 165 °F; eggs turn rubbery if frozen.

recipes.name: Cinnamon-Raisin Overnight Oats (Greek Yogurt)
steps: Stir everything together in jars.
Refrigerate overnight (at least 4 hours).
Top with the fresh mix-ins before serving.
Keeps 3–4 days chilled.

batch.notes: Fridge only, 3 days; mix the Thu–Fri jars on Wednesday.

recipes.name: Classic Buttermilk Pancakes
steps: Whisk dry ingredients; separately whisk wet ingredients.
Combine until just mixed; fold in the mix-ins.
Cook on a buttered griddle until bubbles form; flip once.
Serve warm with maple syrup.

recipes.name: Peaches & Cream Yogurt Parfaits (Vanilla Yogurt)
steps: Layer yogurt, fruit, and granola in glasses.
Repeat the layers and drizzle with honey.
Serve right away (or chill, granola on top).

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon & Spinach & Tomato Scramble with Buttered Toast
steps: Sauté fillings in half the butter.
Add whisked eggs; scramble gently over medium-low heat.
Fold in cheese off the heat.
Serve on or beside buttered sourdough toast.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Mango-Pineapple Smoothie (Almond Milk)
steps: Blend fruit, base, and honey until smooth (thicker for a bowl).
Pour into glasses or bowls.
Top bowls with granola, chia, and extra fruit.
Serve immediately.

batch.notes: Blend fresh; freeze the fruit, not the smoothie.

recipes.name: Everything Avocado Toast on Whole Wheat
steps: Toast the bread until golden and sturdy.

batch.notes: Add the avocado just before eating; it browns and does not freeze.

Add whisked eggs; scramble gently over medium-low heat.
Fold in cheese off the heat.
Serve on or beside buttered sourdough toast.

batch.notes: Pack the parts separately; assemble when you eat.

recipes.name: Strawberry-Mango Smoothie (Greek Yogurt)
steps: Blend fruit, base, and honey until smooth (thicker for a bowl).
Pour into glasses or bowls.
Top bowls with granola, chia, and extra fruit.
Serve immediately.

batch.notes: Blend fresh; freeze the fruit, not the smoothie.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter-Banana Toast on Sourdough
steps: Toast the bread until golden and sturdy.
Prepare and season the topping.
Pile on the topping and finish with flaky salt.
Serve immediately.

batch.notes: Pack the parts separately; assemble when you eat.

recipes.name: Sausage, Egg & American Bagel Sandwiches
steps: Toast the bread and cook the protein.
Fry or scramble the eggs in butter.
Layer protein, egg, and cheese; melt briefly.
Assemble and serve hot.

batch.notes: Pack the parts separately; assemble when you eat.

recipes.name: Steak Breakfast Tacos (Loaded)
steps: Cook the filling protein; scramble in the eggs.
Warm tortillas; layer eggs, filling, and cheese.
Add toppings, roll or fold, and toast seam-side down.
Serve with extra salsa.

batch.notes: Add the avocado just before eating; it browns and does not freeze.

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon Pepper & Onion Frittata with Swiss
steps: Whisk eggs and cream; season well.
Sauté fillings in an oven-safe skillet.
Pour in eggs, scatter cheese, and cook 2 minutes on the stove.
Bake at 400°F until just set, 12–15 minutes.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Kielbasa & Sweet Potato Breakfast Hash with Pepper & Onion
steps: Crisp the potatoes in oil in a large skillet.
Add the protein and vegetables; cook until browned.
Make wells and crack in the eggs; cover until set.
Season with smoked paprika and serve from the pan.

recipes.name: Chocolate Chip Quick Bread Loaf
steps: Whisk dry and wet ingredients separately, then combine.
Fold in the flavor mix-ins without overmixing.
Portion into the pan and add topping if using.
Bake until a tester comes out clean; cool briefly.

recipes.name: Mixed Berry Stovetop Oatmeal
steps: Combine oats, milk, and a pinch of salt.
Cook (or bake) until creamy and tender.
Stir in the flavor mix-ins.
Portion and serve warm.

recipes.name: Mushroom & Onion Omelet with Feta
steps: Whisk eggs with milk, salt, and pepper.
Sauté the fillings in butter until tender; set aside.
Pour eggs into the pan; when nearly set, add fillings and cheese.
Fold, rest 1 minute, and serve.

batch.notes: Reheat to 165 °F; eggs turn rubbery if frozen.

recipes.name: Acaraje black-eyed pea fritters with shrimp filling
steps: Puree onion, ginger, garlic and chilli; fry in oil 5 mins.
Add prawns, tomatoes, coriander and lime; cook 3 mins until prawns are done.
Puree black-eyed peas with garlic and chilli; mix in onion, flour, salt, baking powder; roll 16 balls.
Heat oven to 190C and 8cm oil; fry balls in batches 4-5 mins until golden, drain.
Slice fritters open, spoon in prawn filling and serve with hot sauce.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; it does not freeze well.

recipes.name: Achiote Oil (Aceite Achiotado) Recipe
steps: Heat oil and achiote seeds in a small skillet over medium heat 2-3 mins.
Don't let seeds turn black; remove from heat and let stand 5 mins.
Strain oil and store up to 15 days at room temperature in a sealed jar.

recipes.name: Adana kebab
steps: Finely chop peppers and press out juices; mix with mince, pepper paste, pul biber, salt and 2 tbsp oil.
Knead 2-3 mins until sticky; cover and chill at least 2 hrs.
Heat grill high or oven to 220C; shape into 20cm kofte or onto skewers and press indents.
Brush with remaining oil; grill 10-12 mins turning, or bake 16-18 mins until crisp.

recipes.name: Air Fryer Egg Rolls
steps: Cook ground pork in olive oil over medium heat 6-8 mins until done.
Add garlic, ginger, carrot, scallions and cabbage; cook 3-4 mins, season with soy and vinegar, cool.
Spoon 1/4 cup filling onto each wrapper, wet edges and roll tight into cylinders.
Brush with oil; air fry at 350F for 6-7 mins, flip, oil and cook 4-5 mins more until golden.

recipes.name: Air fryer patatas bravas
steps: Soak potatoes in just-boiled water 30 mins, drain and air-dry 5 mins.
Toss with 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper; air fry at 200C for 20-30 mins until crisp.
Fry onion in remaining oil 8-10 mins; add garlic, paprika, tomato puree, then tomatoes, cook 5-10 mins.
Pour sauce over potatoes, sprinkle with basil and serve.

recipes.name: Ají de Aguacate Recipe (Colombian Spicy Avocado Sauce)
steps: Place all ingredients in a food processor.
Process until the mixture is well combined.
If too thick, add more lime juice to reach the desired consistency.

batch.notes: Add the avocado just before eating; it browns and does not freeze.

recipes.name: Ajo blanco
steps: Soak bread in 350ml water 10 mins.
Blend all ingredients with 350ml water and 1 tsp salt.
Chill 1 hr, then serve with a drizzle of oil and black pepper.

recipes.name: Algerian Bouzgene Berber Bread with Roasted Pepper Sauce
steps: Broil red peppers and tomatoes ~8 mins until skins blacken; peel, core and seed.
Fry jalapenos and garlic in 1 tbsp oil; add to peppers and tomatoes and chop into a soupy sauce.
Mix semolina with salt and 4 tbsp oil; add water gradually to a non-sticky dough, divide into 6.
Roll each ball 1/4 inch thick and fry in 1 tbsp oil until dark spots appear and crisp.
Break off bread and scoop into the sauce to eat.

recipes.name: Algerian Carrots
steps: Steam sliced carrots over 1 1/2 cups water 4-6 mins until tender; reserve 1/2 cup liquid.
Heat oil; add salt, pepper, cinnamon, cumin, garlic and thyme; cook ~10 mins until fragrant.
Add reserved liquid and bay leaf; cover and simmer 20 mins.
Stir in carrots to coat and heat 2-3 mins; add lemon juice, remove bay leaf and serve.

recipes.name: Algerian Flafla (Bell Pepper Salad)
steps: Heat oven to 450F (230C); bake whole peppers 30-45 mins until skins blacken.
Cool 10 mins, then peel, seed and chop into half-inch pieces.
Fry onion in oil ~5 mins until translucent.
Add garlic, salt, pepper, peppers and tomato; cook ~5 mins until well combined.

recipes.name: Algerian Kefta (Meatballs)
steps: Mix ground beef with half the garlic and 1 tbsp onion; shape into 12-14 oblong patties.
Brown patties in a hot skillet ~10 mins until no longer pink; set aside.
Fry remaining onion in drippings ~5 mins; add garlic, tomatoes, parsley, ras el hanout and water.
Cook ~5 mins until tomatoes soften, then pour sauce over meatballs.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Almojábanas (Colombian Cheese Bread)
steps: Preheat oven to 400F.
Mix masarepa and cheese in a food processor; add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Divide into 8 balls and place on a greased baking sheet.
Bake 25-30 mins until golden; serve warm.

recipes.name: Amok Trey – Cambodian Fish Curry
steps: Whisk coconut milk, curry paste, fish sauce, palm sugar and broth until smooth.
Heat oil in a skillet (~350F); pour in sauce and simmer 3-4 mins.
Add fish cubes and kaffir lime leaves; cover and cook low 10 mins until fish flakes.
Stir in beaten egg and cook 2 mins; spoon into banana leaf packets and steam 10 mins.
Garnish with cilantro and lime wedges before serving.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Antiguan Breakfast (Chop Up and ‘Saltfish’)
steps: Peel and chop eggplant and pumpkin into medium pieces.
Saute onions and garlic in butter 2 mins; add pumpkin and eggplant, cook 2-3 mins.
Add water to cover; boil, then simmer until soft.
Stir in spinach and cook 3 mins; drain, then mash vigorously.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.name: Apple Potato Mash (Hete bliksem)
steps: Boil potato chunks in salted water 10 mins; add apples and cinnamon stick, boil 10 mins more.
Fry bacon in a dry pan until crispy, then drain.
Fry apple slices in butter with maple syrup and cinnamon until soft.
Coat cheese in egg then sesame seeds; fry quickly until browned on both sides.
Drain and mash potatoes with apples; season with cinnamon and salt, remove cinnamon stick.

recipes.name: Arepa
steps: Mix corn flour with salted water gradually to form a dough; rest 5 mins.
Shape into rounds about 3 inches wide and 1/2 inch thick.
Cook in a lightly greased skillet until a crust forms on each side.
Bake at 350F about 20 mins until they sound hollow when tapped.

recipes.name: Arepa Pabellón
steps: Cook the shredded meat with salt and pepper; warm beans, fry plantains and dice tomato.
Grill the arepas until golden on each side.
Slice open through the middle and fill with plantain, beans, meat and tomato.
Serve with pico de gallo or guacamole.

recipes.name: Arepa pelua
steps: Cook flank steak in broth with salt over low heat ~2 hrs until tender; shred with forks.
Saute onion, pepper and garlic; add cumin, oregano, paprika, salt and meat, cook a few mins.
Mix cornmeal with warm water and salt into a soft dough; rest 5 mins, form 6 discs.
Cook arepas on a griddle 2-3 mins per side until golden.
Slice open, fill with shredded beef and top with grated cheese.

recipes.name: Arroz al horno (baked rice)
steps: Heat oven to 200C; brown pork belly in oil in batches, then fry black pudding and bacon.
Fry onion and peppers 10 mins, add tomato, garlic, paprika and chilli, then return the meats.
Add beans, stock and herb and bring to the boil.
Scatter rice around the pork, push under the stock; bake uncovered 20 mins until tender.
Squeeze over lemon and drizzle with oil before serving.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Arroz con gambas y calamar
steps: Peel and devein most prawns; fry onion in oil 5 mins.
Add bay leaf, saffron, rice and tomato puree, cook 1-2 mins.
Pour in wine, then stock and 150ml water; cook 5 mins, add squid, simmer covered 12 mins.
Stir in peeled prawns, top with whole prawns, simmer 5-6 mins until pink, then rest.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Asado
steps: Start a wood fire and let it burn down to coals.
Generously salt the beef cuts.
Grill beef with thickest cuts farthest from coals; add chorizo and morcilla later.
Cook, turning occasionally, until desired doneness (ribs up to 2 hrs).
Rest 10 mins, then slice; serve with chimichurri and grilled vegetables.

recipes.name: Aubergine & hummus grills
steps: Brush aubergine slices with oil, season and grill 15 mins turning until soft.
Whizz bread into crumbs with 2 tsp oil.
Spread hummus on each slice, press hummus-side into crumbs; grill 3 mins until golden.
Toss walnuts, parsley and tomatoes with lemon juice and oil; serve with grills and pitta.

recipes.name: Aubergine couscous salad
steps: Heat grill high; brush aubergine with oil, season and grill 15 mins turning until soft.
Cover couscous with the stock and leave 10 mins.
Mix tomatoes, mint, goat's cheese and the remaining oil.
Fluff the couscous, then stir in aubergines, tomato mix and lemon juice.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Aussie Burgers
steps: Season mince with salt and pepper; shape into 4 burgers with wet hands.
Slice the beetroot and split the naan breads.
Toast naans on a griddle; cook burgers 2-3 mins per side.
Top naan with rocket, burger, beetroot and soured cream; season and serve.

batch.notes: Cream sauces can separate if frozen; refrigerate and eat by day 3.

recipes.name: Avocado dip with new potatoes
steps: Whizz half the avocado with yogurt, lime, lemon juice and seasoning.
Dice the remaining avocado and stir in with most of the lime zest; chill.
Boil potatoes 6 mins, drain and toss with oil, chilli powder and cumin seeds.
Heat oven to 200C and roast potatoes ~30 mins until golden.
Serve dip scattered with lime zest, with hot potatoes and tortilla chips.

batch.notes: Add the avocado just before eating; it browns and does not freeze.

recipes.name: Baba Ghanoush
steps: Grill pricked eggplants over medium-high, turning, until collapsed and very soft, 25-30 min.
Cover with foil 15 min, then scrape flesh into a colander and drain 5-10 min.
Mash flesh with crushed garlic and salt until creamy, about 5 min.
Whisk in lemon juice, tahini, olive oil and cayenne, then stir in yogurt.
Chill until cold, then fold in mint and parsley and adjust seasoning.

recipes.name: Bahia-style Moqueca prawn stew
steps: Marinate prawns in lime juice, salt and garlic; chill 1 hr.
Fry spring onion and onion in coconut oil 5 min, then add pepper, chilli, paprika, garlic.
Add tomatoes, coconut milk and salt; simmer to reduce 10 min.
Add prawns with marinade and lime juice; simmer until white, about 3 min.
Serve with fresh coriander and rice.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Bai Sach Chrouk – Grilled Pork with Rice
steps: Mix coconut milk, soy, oyster sauce, honey, garlic and pepper for the marinade.
Coat sliced pork shoulder and refrigerate at least 30 min.
Rinse jasmine rice, then simmer covered in 4 cups water 15 min until tender.
Grill pork on an oiled pan at 400F, 3-4 min per side to 145F internal.
Rest 5 min, slice; serve over rice with cucumber and cilantro.

batch.notes: Add the cucumber fresh; it turns watery in storage.

recipes.name: Baingan Bharta
steps: Oil the aubergine and roast over an open flame, turning, until charred and tender.
Cool in water, peel the skin, then finely chop or mash the flesh.
Saute onions and garlic in oil until translucent, add green chilli 1 min.
Add tomatoes and cook until oil separates, then stir in red chilli powder.
Mix in mashed aubergine, season with salt, saute 4-5 min, finish with coriander.

recipes.name: Bajan Salt Bread Recipe
steps: Mix half the flour with salt and yeast, add warm water to a stiff dough.
Add more flour, knead 10 min until smooth, then rest in a greased bowl 40-50 min till doubled.
Preheat oven to 425F/220C.
Divide into 12 balls, place on a greased sheet, and prove 40 min until doubled.
Bake 25-30 min until golden and hollow-sounding.

recipes.name: Bajan Sweet Bread
steps: Combine flour, baking powder and salt in a bowl; melt the butter.
Mix coconut, most of the sugar, raisins, egg, milk, almond essence and melted butter to a paste.
Stir paste into the flour to a stiff dough; divide between baking tins.
Brush tops with sugar-water and bake in the center of the oven 1 hour.
Cool in tins, then slice and serve.

recipes.name: Baked salmon with fennel & tomatoes
steps: Heat oven to 180C/160C fan. Reserve fennel fronds; cut bulbs into wedges.
Boil fennel wedges in salted water 10 min, then drain well.
Mix chopped fronds with parsley and lemon zest.
Spread fennel and tomatoes in a dish, drizzle with oil and bake 10 min.
Nestle salmon in, sprinkle lemon juice, bake 15 min; scatter parsley and olives.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Balchi di Pisca
steps: Soak salt cod 24 hrs, discard water, then simmer in fresh water until it flakes.
Debone cod; boil diced potatoes until tender, drain, and mash with the cod.
Blend tomato, green pepper, onion, garlic, Tabasco, nutmeg, salt and pepper to a sauce.
Mix sauce into the fish, then beat in egg to a stiff moldable mixture.
Form 1.5-inch balls and deep-fry until golden brown.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Bang bang prawn salad
steps: Cook rice noodles per pack, rinse under cold water and drain thoroughly.
Melt peanut butter, coconut milk, sweet chilli and half the spring onions, loosen with water.
Mix noodles, cucumber and beansprouts in a serving dish.
Top with prawns, drizzle peanut sauce and scatter remaining spring onions.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; it does not freeze well.

recipes.name: Bangladeshi fish curry with daikon
steps: Prep fish into chunks, rinse and drain. Peel daikon and slice into 2cm half-moons.
Fry crushed garlic in oil 1 min, add onion paste and salt, cook 3-5 min till soft.
Add 200ml water, cover 10 min, then stir in ground spices and cook briefly.
Add daikon and 200ml water, cover 10 min; add fish, coat, cover 5 min without stirring.
Pour in 500ml hot water, simmer 15 min, add coriander and chillies, cook 5 min; serve with lime.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Barbados Pepperpot
steps: Marinate cubed stewing steak in lime juice; slice garlic, onion, herbs and scotch bonnets.
Boil pig's trotters, drain, then add steak and oxtail with fresh hot water.
Add garlic, onion, peppers, cinnamon, cloves, herbs, salt and sugar.
Simmer until the meat is tender.
Reheat the whole pot to boiling over several days to deepen the flavor.

recipes.name: Barbecue pork buns
steps: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan. Mix sugar into bread mix, add water and knead 5 min; prove till doubled.
Fry bacon until crisp, add ginger and garlic 1 min, then soy, honey and tomato puree.
Knead dough, divide into 12 balls, flatten and add a blob of filling.
Pinch each closed into a purse, sit sealed-side down and prove 30 min till pillowy.
Brush with egg and bake 20 min until golden; serve warm with dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Barramundi with Moroccan spices
steps: Blitz spices, garlic, lemon, olive oil and coriander with salt to a dressing.
Slash fish 3 times per side, coat with half the dressing, marinate 30 min.
Heat oven to 220C/200C fan.
Roast fish on a tray 20 min until flesh is firm and eyes turn white.
Serve with the remaining dressing and couscous or rice.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: BBQ Pork Sloppy Joes
steps: Heat oven to 450F. Toss sweet potato wedges with oil, salt and pepper; roast 20-25 min.
Thinly slice some onion, chop the rest; chop garlic; juice lime; butter and halve buns.
Quick-pickle the sliced onion in lime juice, sugar and salt.
Cook chopped onion in oil 4-5 min, add garlic, then brown pork 4-6 min.
Stir in BBQ sauce, pickling liquid, ketchup, sugar and water; simmer to thicken, fill toasted buns.

recipes.name: Bean & Sausage Hotpot
steps: Fry sausages in a large casserole until browned all over, about 10 min.
Add tomato sauce and stir, then mix in beans, treacle and mustard.
Bring to a simmer, cover and cook 30 min.
Serve with crusty bread or rice.

recipes.name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
steps: Marinate the beef in soy, rice wine, cornstarch and pepper 10 min.
Mix oyster sauce, rice wine, soy and chicken stock for the sauce.
Blanch broccoli in boiling water about 2 min until crisp-tender, then drain.
Stir-fry beef in hot oil 1 min, flip, add garlic and cook 30-60 sec.
Add sauce and cornstarch slurry, stir until thick, fold in broccoli; serve with rice.

recipes.name: Beef and Mustard Pie
steps: Heat oven to 150C/300F. Toss beef in seasoned flour and brown in batches in oil.
Return beef, add wine and reduce by half, then add stock, onion, carrots, thyme, mustard.
Cover and braise in the oven 2 hrs; cool and remove the thyme.
Heat oven to 200C/400F. Fill pie dish, brush rim with egg yolk, top with pastry, glaze.
Bake 30 min until golden; serve with buttered green beans.

recipes.name: Beef and Oyster pie
steps: Season and brown beef cubes in oil in batches; transfer to a casserole.
Fry shallots, garlic and bacon, add to beef with herbs. Heat oven to 180C/350F.
Deglaze pan with stout, pour over beef with stock, cover and braise 1.5-2 hrs.
Stir in cornflour paste, simmer to thicken and cool. Make pastry from flour, butter, water.
Line dish, fill with beef and oysters, top with pastry, glaze; bake 25-30 min at 200C/400F.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Beef Asado
steps: Marinate beef with peppercorn, soy, vinegar, bay, lemon and tomato sauce 30 min.
Simmer beef with marinade, water and beef cube, covered, 40 min on low.
Turn beef, add tomato paste and cook until tender; set aside.
Fry potato and carrots until browned; saute onion and garlic in reserved oil.
Add stew sauce and beef, simmer 2 min, melt in butter and reduce by half.

recipes.name: Beef Banh Mi Bowls with Sriracha Mayo, Carrot & Pickled Cucumber
steps: Rinse rice, then simmer covered in water with salt 15 min; rest off the heat.
Chop garlic, zest and quarter lime, slice cucumber, dice onion, grate carrot.
Quick-pickle cucumber in lime juice, sugar and salt; mix sriracha mayo with garlic and lime.
Cook onion in oil 4-5 min, add beef, garlic and sugar, brown 4-5 min, stir in soy.
Fluff rice with lime zest and butter; top with beef, carrot, cucumber and sriracha mayo.

batch.notes: Add the cucumber fresh; it turns watery in storage.

recipes.name: Beef Brisket Pot Roast
steps: Score the fat cross-hatch, salt the brisket well and rest 30 min at room temperature.
Sear brisket fatty-side down 5-8 min until browned, then brown the other side; remove.
Saute onions in the fat until browned, add garlic 1-2 min. Heat oven to 300F.
Nestle brisket with beef stock and tied herbs, cover and braise 3 hrs, flipping hourly.
Add carrots, cook 1 hr more till tender; rest brisket, slice across the grain, serve.

recipes.name: Beef Caldereta
steps: Saute onion and garlic in oil until softened, then brown the beef.
Add soy sauce, tomato sauce and water, and bring to a boil.
Add the beef cube and pressure-cook 30 min.
Fry carrot and potato until browned; stir chilli, liver spread and peanut butter into the stew.
Add bell peppers, potato and carrot, cover 5-7 min; season and serve.

recipes.name: Beef Dumpling Stew
steps: Heat oven to 180C/350F. Brown beef in oil and butter in an ovenproof casserole.
Sprinkle over flour, cook 2-3 min, add garlic and vegetables, fry 1-2 min.
Stir in wine, stock, herbs, Worcestershire and balsamic; season and braise 2 hrs covered.
Make dumplings from flour, baking powder, salt, suet and water; roll into balls.
Add dumplings on top, cook 20 min until swollen; serve with mash and parsley.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Cabbage Soup (Shchi)
steps: Melt butter in a Dutch oven over medium heat; saute onion until translucent.
Add cabbage, carrot and celery; saute about 3 min until softening.
Add bay leaf and stock, boil, then cover and simmer 15 min until crisp-tender.
Add potatoes; simmer covered 10 min, then add tomatoes and simmer 5 min.
Season, discard bay leaf, and serve topped with sour cream and dill.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Cacik
steps: Strain yogurt in a cloth-lined sieve in the fridge at least 12 hrs.
Stir lemon juice, most of the olive oil and dried mint, then mix in the yogurt.
Halve, seed and coarsely grate cucumber, then squeeze out as much liquid as possible.
Fold grated cucumber, garlic and 3/4 tsp salt into the yogurt.
Garnish with olive oil and dried mint.

batch.notes: Add the cucumber fresh; it turns watery in storage.

recipes.name: Cajun spiced fish tacos
steps: Coat fish all over with cajun spice, cayenne and seasoning.
Fry fish in a little oil over medium until golden, then lower and cook through ~10 min.
Combine all dressing ingredients with a little seasoning.
Warm tortillas in the microwave for 5-10 sec.
Fill with avocado, lettuce, spring onion, salsa, fish flakes and dressing.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; it does not freeze well.

recipes.name: Callaloo and SaltFish
steps: Soak salted fish overnight, then boil, drain, cool and shred.
Cook bacon until crispy; drain all but 1 tbsp of the grease.
Saute onion, green onion, scotch bonnet and garlic about 2 min until soft.
Add shredded fish and cook about 1 min.
Add callaloo, tomatoes, thyme and pepper; cook ~2 min until heated through.

recipes.name: Callaloo Jamaican Style
steps: Soak kale leaves in cold water; slice onions, mince garlic, dice tomatoes.
Cook bacon until crispy, then add onion, garlic and thyme for a minute.
Add tomatoes, scotch bonnet and smoked paprika; saute 2-3 min.
Add kale and salt; steam 6-8 min until tender, adding a little water as needed.
Fry seasoned plantain slices until browned; serve with the kale.

recipes.name: Camaro Grelhado Com Molho Cru (Grilled Prawns with Green Onion Sauce)
steps: Grind all the sauce ingredients into a paste.
Skewer the prawns and brush with sauce.
Grill 3-4 min per side until they lose their translucent color.
Serve with extra sauce on the side.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Cambodian Stir-fried Morning Glory with Pork, Fermented Soybeans, and Garlic
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over medium; stir-fry garlic ~30 sec until fragrant.
Add minced pork, breaking it up, and stir-fry 2-3 min until browned.
Stir in fermented soybeans and cook 1 min.
Toss in morning glory and stir-fry 2-3 min to keep it green and crisp.
Adjust with fish sauce or sugar; serve immediately with steamed rice.

batch.notes: The coating softens in storage; re-crisp in the oven or an air fryer.

recipes.name: Carbonada Criolla
steps: Brown the beef cubes in a large pot, then remove and set aside.
Saute onion until translucent, then add carrots, potatoes and pumpkin a few min.
Return the beef, add broth and dried apricots, and season.
Simmer 1-2 hours until the beef is tender.
Serve hot with a crusty piece of bread.

recipes.name: Cassava pizza
steps: Preheat the oven to 200C.
Cut the bacon or chorizo into pieces and the paprika into strips.
Spread tomato sauce and mozzarella on each cassava portion.
Top with bacon/chorizo, corn, turkey ham, olives and paprika.
Bake 7-10 min, then serve.

recipes.name: Cevapi Sausages
steps: Place ground meat in a bowl with finely chopped onion and grated garlic.
Add parsley, paprika, baking soda, breadcrumbs, water, Vegeta, salt and pepper; mix well.
Cover and rest in the fridge for 1-2 hours.
Shape into thumb-thick rolls about 7-10 cm long.
Grill 12-14 min, turning, until browned and cooked through; serve hot.

recipes.name: Chakchouka
steps: Heat oil in a lidded skillet over medium-high; saute onion 2-3 min.
Add peppers and garlic; saute another 3-5 min.
Add tomatoes, cumin, paprika, salt and chili; simmer uncovered 10-15 min until thick.
Make four craters and crack an egg into each.
Cover and simmer 5-7 min until the eggs set; serve with bread.

recipes.name: Challah
steps: Dissolve yeast with a pinch of sugar in warm water; leave 10 min until foamy.
Mix flour, sugar and salt; add half the egg, yeast, oil and 200ml warm water into a dough.
Knead 10 min until smooth, then rise covered in an oiled bowl 1 hr until doubled.
Divide into three, roll into ropes and plait; rise about 40 min until puffy.
Brush with egg, add seeds, and bake at 200C 25-30 min until golden and hollow.

recipes.name: Cheese Borek
steps: Whisk egg, parsley, garlic and red pepper, then mix in Gouda and Emmentaler.
Brush a phyllo sheet with butter and cut lengthwise into 4 strips.
Place filling at one end and fold in triangles down each strip.
Preheat oven to 175C and butter a baking sheet.
Arrange the triangles and bake about 30 min until lightly browned; serve warm.

recipes.name: Cheese Sticks
steps: Cut the cheese into long strips and chill in the fridge.
Mix flour, butter and egg with sugar, salt and olive oil.
Gradually add milk and knead to a smooth dough.
Roll out, cut into strips and wrap spirally around each cheese strip, sealing fully.
Dust with flour and fry in hot oil until golden.

recipes.name: Chick-Fil-A Sandwich
steps: Pound the chicken to 1/2 inch and cut into two even pieces.
Marinate in pickle juice for 30-60 min.
Beat egg with milk; combine flour, sugar and spices separately.
Dip chicken in the egg, then coat in flour.
Fry in 345-350F oil 2 min per side until golden; serve on toasted buns with pickles.

batch.notes: Pack the parts separately; assemble when you eat.

recipes.name: Chicken & chorizo rice pot
steps: Heat oil in a casserole and brown chicken on all sides in batches; set aside.
Cook onion and pepper 10 min, then add garlic and chorizo 2 min and tomato puree 1 min.
Return chicken with thyme, wine and stock; boil, cover and cook 30 min.
Stir in the rice, cover and cook 15 min until absorbed.
Rest 10 min, season and scatter with parsley.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Chicken & mushroom Hotpot
steps: Heat oven to 200C; cook onion in butter 5 min, then add mushrooms.
Stir in flour to make a roux and cook 2 min over low heat.
Slowly add stock, season with pepper, nutmeg and mustard, then boil to thicken.
Stir in cooked chicken and vegetables and pour into a buttered pie dish.
Layer potatoes on top, brush with butter and bake ~35 min until golden.

recipes.name: Chicken Alfredo Primavera
steps: Sear seasoned chicken in butter and oil 5-7 min per side until cooked; rest and slice.
Boil pasta in salted water until al dente ~12 min, reserving 1/2 cup water.
Saute veggies and pepper flakes in the same pan ~5 min, then add garlic 1 min.
Deglaze with white wine and reduce by half about 3 min.
Stir in milk, cream and pasta water; simmer, then add Parmesan, pasta and chicken.

batch.notes: Cream sauces can separate if frozen; refrigerate and eat by day 3.

recipes.name: Chicken and Potato Roti
steps: Caramelize sugar, then brown cubed chicken in it with a pint of stock.
Add onion, garlic, herbs, jerk seasoning, salt and whole scotch bonnet; simmer 25 min.
Rub shortening into salted flour to breadcrumbs, add water and form a soft dough.
Roll wafer-thin roti skins and cook 1 min per side until browned.
Add cubed potatoes and 1/2 pint water; cook 30 min, then fill skins and serve.

recipes.name: Chicken Basquaise
steps: Heat oven to 180C; brown seasoned chicken in butter and oil in batches, then set aside.
Fry onions 10 min, add peppers 5 min, then chorizo, sun-dried tomatoes and garlic 2-3 min.
Stir in rice, then tomato paste, paprika, bay leaves and thyme.
Add stock and wine; simmer, press rice down and lay chicken, lemon and olives on top.
Cover and bake 50 min until rice is tender and chicken juices run clear.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Chicken Congee
steps: Marinate chicken with salt, white pepper and ginger juice.
Rinse the rice, then boil with 8 cups water.
Reduce to low and simmer 20-25 min, stirring every 8-10 min.
Add the marinated chicken and cook 10 min more.
Stir in green onion, ginger, salt and pepper; serve, optionally topped with coriander.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Chicken Couscous
steps: Cook onion in olive oil 1-2 min until softened.
Add chicken and fry 7-10 min until cooked and onions golden.
Grate in ginger and stir in harissa; cook 1 min.
Add apricots, chickpeas, couscous and stock; stir once.
Cover 5 min until couscous soaks up the stock, then fluff and scatter coriander.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
steps: Cut chicken into pieces and cook in enchilada sauce ~20 min until done.
Shred the chicken with two forks.
Preheat oven to 375F and spread sauce over a baking dish.
Layer tortillas, chicken, sauce and cheese, then repeat for three layers.
Bake 20-30 min uncovered until bubbly and the cheese browns.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Chicken Fajita Mac and Cheese
steps: Fry onion, peppers and garlic in olive oil until translucent.
Make a well, add chicken with seasoning and salt, and let it colour.
Add cream, stock and macaroni; cook on low 20 min.
Stir in the cheeses until combined.
Top with roasted peppers and parsley.

batch.notes: Cream sauces can separate if frozen; refrigerate and eat by day 3.

recipes.name: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Use day-old rice; chop chicken into small cubes and salt for 10 min.
Scramble the whisked eggs in oil, then set aside.
Cook chicken 4-5 min in oil, then set aside.
Saute onion, garlic, ginger, carrots and peas until tender.
Add rice, scallions and five-spice, then soy and sesame oil; fold in egg and chicken.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Chicken Ham and Leek Pie
steps: Simmer chicken breast in stock 10 min, then remove; reserve the liquor.
Soften leeks in butter, add garlic, then flour and gradually milk, stock and wine.
Simmer 3 min, season, stir in cream and cool.
Line a pie dish with pastry; fill with chopped chicken, ham and leek sauce.
Top with a pastry lid, glaze with egg and bake at 200C 35-40 min until golden.

batch.notes: Cream sauces can separate if frozen; refrigerate and eat by day 3.

recipes.name: Chicken Handi
steps: Heat oil and fry sliced onion until deep golden; remove and set aside.
Saute garlic, then tomatoes ~5 min until soft; return onion and add ginger paste.
Add cumin, coriander seeds, green chillies, turmeric and chilli powder; saute.
Add chicken and salt; cook covered on medium-low ~15 min until nearly done.
Stir in yogurt on low, then cream, kasuri methi and garam masala; serve with naan.

batch.notes: Cream sauces can separate if frozen; refrigerate and eat by day 3.

recipes.name: Chicken Karaage
steps: Whisk ginger, garlic, soy, sake and sugar; coat chicken and refrigerate at least 1 hr.
Heat 1 inch of oil to 360F.
Toss the chicken in potato starch to coat evenly.
Fry in batches until medium brown and cooked through.
Optionally fry a second time for extra crispness; serve with lemon.

recipes.name: Chicken Liver Pate Recipe
steps: Clean the livers of sinews and gall.
Put in a casserole with all other ingredients roughly chopped and season.
Cover with milk and cook in a slow 300F oven for 2 hours.
Liquidize in a blender and adjust seasoning; add sherry or brandy.
Put in a dish and cover with melted butter.

recipes.name: Dal fry
steps: Soak toor dal 1 hr, drain, then simmer with water, salt and turmeric ~30 min to a thick soup.
Heat ghee; crackle cumin and mustard seeds, add bay, chilli, ginger and chilli powder.
Add tomatoes, salt and sugar; cook until mushy, then stir in cilantro and garam masala 1 min.
Pour the seasoning over the dal, mix and cook 1 min; serve with naan.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Dolma Japrak Stuffed Vine Leaves
steps: Fry onions in olive oil 5 min until browning.
Off heat, mix in meat, rice, pepper, paprika, stock, parsley and basil.
Wrap spoonfuls in overlapping vine leaves, folding into parcels.
Line a pan with leaves, pack parcels in layers, cover with boiling water.
Simmer covered 1.5 hrs until water absorbed; cool 10 min and serve.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Drunken noodles (pad kee mao)
steps: Cook rice noodles per pack, drain; mix all sauce ingredients in a bowl.
Stir-fry garlic and chilli in hot oil 20 sec, add steak 1 min until seared.
Add broccoli 1 min, then noodles and sauce; stir-fry 1-2 min until hot.
Stir through basil off the heat and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Duck Confit
steps: A day ahead, salt-cure duck legs with garlic and herbs; chill overnight.
Brush off salt; cook legs skin-down in wine, barely simmering, covered 2 hrs until tender.
Cool in their fat; store submerged in fat up to a month if preparing ahead.
To crisp, roast skin-down at 220C/200C fan 30-40 min, turning, until brown.
Serve with gravy, salad and crisp potatoes.

recipes.name: Dutch poffertjes (mini pancakes)
steps: Dissolve yeast in some lukewarm milk.
Mix buckwheat and flour, add the yeast, then milk, to a smooth batter.
Stir in eggs, salt and vanilla sugar; rest 45 min to rise.
Butter a poffertjes pan, half-fill holes, cook until tops dry, then flip and brown.
Serve with butter and icing sugar.

recipes.name: Easy Spanish chicken
steps: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan. Fry onion, chorizo and peppers in oil 15 min until softened.
Add paprika and garlic, cook a few mins until fragrant.
Stir in tomatoes, olives and butter beans; season.
Nestle in chicken thighs and bake 40 min until skin is crisp and chicken cooked.
Scatter with parsley and serve.

recipes.name: Egg Drop Soup
steps: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a wok.
Add salt, sugar, white pepper and sesame oil, then the vegetables.
Thicken with a slurry of 1 tbsp cornstarch and 2 tbsp water to desired consistency.
Slowly stir in a beaten egg and stir 8 seconds.
Serve topped with green onions.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Egg Foo Young
steps: Simmer beef stock, soy, wine, oyster sauce and pepper; thicken with cornstarch slurry 2-3 min.
Whisk cornstarch, water, eggs, salt and sugar; stir in green onion, bean sprouts and shrimp.
Heat 2 inches of oil in a wok to 350F.
Ladle in 1/4 of the batter; fry ~2 min per side until golden and puffed. Repeat for 4 omelets.
Serve over rice with the warm gravy spooned over.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Eggplant Adobo
steps: Cut eggplant into pieces, toss with sugar, salt and pepper; rest 20 min to 2 hrs.
Fry half the garlic in oil until crisp for chips; remove and season.
Brown ground pork in the pot, then brown eggplant in batches; set aside.
Deglaze with 1.5 cups water; add garlic, vinegar, soy, bay, pepper and sugar.
Return pork and eggplant, simmer 20-25 min until tender; top with garlic chips, serve with rice.

recipes.name: Egyptian Fatteh
steps: Fry torn pita in butter until golden; toss with butter, garlic and cumin, set in a dish.
Brown beef, add onion, seasoning, stock cube and water; simmer ~2 hrs, reserve broth.
Toast vermicelli in butter, add rice, then water and salt; simmer ~35 min until tender.
Saturate the bread with broth, layer rice on top, then more broth to the rice line.
Make a garlic-cumin tomato sauce and fried garlic-cumin beef; spoon over and serve.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Empanadas
steps: Mix flour and salt, rub in butter, add water to a dough; chill 30 min.
Cook onions until translucent, brown the beef, stir in spices, cool, then add eggs and olives.
Roll dough, cut circles, fill, fold and seal the edges with a fork.
Bake at 200C (400F) 20-25 min until golden.

recipes.name: English Breakfast
steps: Heat an oiled grill plate on low; cook sausages 15-20 min, turning, then raise to medium.
Fry bacon 2-4 min per side; cook mushrooms 4-6 min and tomatoes cut-side down 4-5 min.
Fry black pudding slices 1.5-2 min per side until crisp.
Fry bread in a separate oiled pan 2-3 min per side; fry eggs, basting with butter.
Serve on warm plates with ketchup or brown sauce.

recipes.name: Escovitch Fish
steps: Season fish with lemon/lime, salt and pepper; keep warm.
Fry fish in oil over medium 5-7 min per side until crisp; remove, leaving 2-3 tbsp oil.
Stir-fry bay leaf, garlic and ginger 1 min without burning.
Add onion, peppers, thyme, scotch bonnet, sugar and allspice 2-3 min; add vinegar, simmer 2 min.
Discard bay and thyme; serve the sauce over the fish.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Ezme
steps: Blitz tomatoes and peppers until finely chopped; strain in a sieve.
Blitz onions, garlic and parsley until finely chopped; set aside.
Whisk pepper paste, tomato puree, molasses, pul biber, sumac, mint and most of the oil.
Stir in the onion mix, strained peppers and salt; drizzle with remaining oil to serve.

recipes.name: Gambas al ajillo
steps: Peel the prawns leaving tails on, devein and season with sea salt.
Heat garlic, olive oil and chillies in a pan over high heat until garlic turns golden.
Add prawns and cook 1-2 min per side until just pink.
Sprinkle with parsley and black pepper; serve immediately.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Garlicky prawns with sherry
steps: Heat olive oil in a large frying pan; cook garlic slices a few seconds.
Add prawns and cook a couple of mins until turning pink.
Pour over the sherry and cook a few mins until prawns are cooked through.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: General Tsos Chicken
steps: Mix the sauce: water, soy, vinegar, sherry, pepper, ginger, garlic, hot pepper, ketchup, hoisin, sugar.
Marinate chicken with salt, pepper, egg whites and cornstarch.
Deep-fry chicken at 350F for 3-4 min until golden; set aside.
Boil the sauce with broccoli in a wok; thicken with cornstarch slurry.
Add chicken, stir-fry 1 min and serve.

recipes.name: Gigantes Plaki
steps: Soak beans overnight; simmer ~50 min until slightly tender, then drain.
Heat oven to 180C/160C fan. Cook onion and garlic in oil 10 min until soft.
Add tomato puree 1 min, then remaining ingredients; simmer 2-3 min and season.
Stir in beans, tip into an ovenproof dish and bake ~1 hr uncovered until tender.
Cool, then scatter with parsley and drizzle with oil.

recipes.name: Golabki (cabbage roll)
steps: Boil the cabbage head 3 min, cool, then remove 18 leaves; chop the rest into a dish.
Cook onion in butter until tender; cool, then mix with beef, pork, rice, garlic, salt and pepper.
Preheat oven to 350F (175C). Roll 1/2 cup filling in each leaf into parcels.
Layer rolls over the chopped cabbage; whisk tomato soup, juice and ketchup and pour over.
Cover with foil and bake ~1 hr until tender.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Griddled aubergines with sesame dressing
steps: Brush aubergine slices with oil and season.
Griddle 2-3 min per side until golden and tender.
Mix yogurt with tahini, garlic, lemon juice and herbs; season.
Top the aubergines with dressing and scatter with herb leaves.

recipes.name: Griddled flatbreads
steps: Mix flours, yeast, sugar and salt; add 350ml warm water and oil to a soft dough.
Mix 1 min, then leave until doubled, about 1 hr.
Knock back, roll out and cut into 10cm squares; rest 30 min until starting to rise.
Cook on BBQ racks a couple of mins until puffed, then flip and cook the other side.
Serve with dips.

recipes.name: Grilled aubergines with spicy chickpeas & walnut sauce
steps: Fry onion in 2 tbsp oil 10 min; add chilli, ginger and spices.
Stir in chickpeas, tomatoes and 5 tbsp water; simmer 10 min, then season with lemon.
Brush aubergines with oil, season and grill both sides until tender and golden.
Mix yogurt with garlic, most of the walnuts, coriander and seasoning.
Top aubergines with the chickpea mix, drizzle walnut sauce, scatter remaining walnuts.

recipes.name: Grilled eggplant with coconut milk
steps: Prick the eggplants all over with a fork.
Grill, turning often, until the skins are dark and the flesh is soft.
Soak in water to cool, then peel and place in a shallow dish.
Mix coconut milk, lemon powder, salt and hot pepper; adjust to taste.
Pour over the eggplant, scatter with green onions and stir gently.

recipes.name: Grilled Mac and Cheese Sandwich
steps: Boil macaroni in salted water 8-10 min until al dente; drain.
Whisk flour, mustard, garlic powder, salt, pepper and cayenne; cook in melted butter 1 min.
Whisk in milk and cream 2 min, melt in the cheese, then stir in pasta.
Spread on a lined sheet, cover and chill ~1 hr until firm; cut into 8 pieces.
Butter bread, layer cheddar, mac and jack; griddle ~4 min per side until golden.

batch.notes: Cream sauces can separate if frozen; refrigerate and eat by day 3.

recipes.name: Grilled Portuguese sardines
steps: Mix all ingredients except the sardines with seasoning.
Pour over the sardines in a dish, toss well, cover and chill a few hours.
Heat a BBQ or griddle until hot; cook sardines 4-5 min per side until charred.
Drizzle with oil, sprinkle with paprika and squeeze over lemon.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Grits
steps: Bring salted water to a boil and add the grits.
Reduce heat, cover and cook ~15 min, stirring occasionally, to desired consistency.
Cool slightly, then serve.

recipes.name: Haft Mewa Recipe
steps: Wash apricots and both raisins; cover with cold water 5cm above the fruit.
Soak walnuts, pistachios and almonds in boiling water, then peel off the skins.
Combine fruits, nuts and cherries with the soaking juice and rose water.
Cover and refrigerate 2 days until the juice turns sweet and syrupy.
Spoon into bowls and serve.

recipes.name: Ham croquetas
steps: Fry leek in oil, stir in ham 1 min, then flour, cooking ~5 min until golden.
Heat stock and milk, season with nutmeg, and gradually stir into the mixture.
Cook ~10 min until very thick; spread on a tray, cover and chill 1 hr.
Roll walnut-sized balls, coat in flour, egg then breadcrumbs; chill 30 min.
Deep-fry at 180C a couple of mins until golden; drain and eat straight away.

recipes.name: Ham hock colcannon
steps: Boil potato chunks in salted water 10-15 min until tender.
Melt butter and cook garlic, cabbage and spring onions until wilted; set aside.
Drain and steam-dry potatoes, then mash with cream, mustard and seasoning.
Stir in the cabbage and ham hock; keep warm.
Fry eggs in the cabbage pan and serve each bowl of colcannon topped with one.

batch.notes: Cream sauces can separate if frozen; refrigerate and eat by day 3.

recipes.name: Hodge Podge
steps: Par-cook carrots and potatoes in boiling salted water 5 min, then blanch peas and beans 1 min; drain.
Melt butter in a heavy pot and warm the vegetables through.
Add milk and cream and bring to a boil, then lower heat and season.
Add dill and chives and simmer at least 10 min; serve warm.

batch.notes: Cream sauces can separate if frozen; refrigerate and eat by day 3.

recipes.name: Home-made Mandazi
steps: Mix self-raising flour, cinnamon and sugar.
Whisk the egg into the milk, then mix into the flour to form a dough.
Knead 3-4 min until smooth; cover and rest 15 min.
Roll to 1cm thick and cut into desired shapes.
Deep-fry until light brown on each side; serve warm or cold.

recipes.name: Honey Balsamic Chicken with Crispy Broccoli & Potatoes
steps: Preheat oven to 425F. Roast potato wedges with oil, salt and pepper 5 min.
Add garlic-oil-tossed broccoli to the sheet; roast 15-20 min more until crispy.
Season chicken and pan-sear in oil 5-6 min per side until cooked; rest.
Cook garlic, then add vinegar, honey, stock and water; simmer 2-3 min until glossy, stir in butter.
Coat chicken in the glaze and serve with broccoli and potatoes.

recipes.name: Honey Teriyaki Salmon
steps: Whisk together the honey teriyaki glaze ingredients until well blended.
Combine the salmon with the glaze.
Pan-fry the salmon in oil on both sides over medium-low until cooked and the glaze thickens.
Garnish with sesame seeds and serve immediately.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Hot and Sour Soup
steps: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a wok.
Add salt, sugar, sesame oil, pepper, hot sauce, vinegar and soy; stir.
Add tofu, mushrooms and wood ear mushrooms.
Thicken with a slurry of 1 tbsp cornstarch and 2 tbsp water.
Stir in a beaten egg 8 seconds; top with bbq pork and green onions.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Hot cumin lamb wrap with crunchy slaw & spicy mayo
steps: Rub lamb steaks with oil, cumin and seasoning; griddle 3-4 min per side, then rest.
Dissolve sugar in vinegar, then toss with carrots, spring onions, cabbage and seasoning.
Blitz the peppers with the mayo in a food processor.
Pile salad onto flatbreads, top with sliced lamb and resting juices.
Spoon over the mayo, scatter with peppers and roll up.

batch.notes: Keep cold; mayonnaise dressings separate if frozen.

recipes.name: Hummus
steps: Drain the chickpeas, reserving the liquid.
Blend chickpeas, tahini, garlic and yogurt until smooth.
Whizz in reserved liquid a tbsp at a time to a nice consistency.
Stir in a squeeze of lemon juice and season to taste.

recipes.name: Fainá
steps: Whisk chickpea flour, water, salt and pepper; rest at least 4 hours (or overnight).
Heat oiled round dish in 220C (430F) oven, pour in batter.
Bake 25-30 min until golden.
Slice and serve hot with black pepper.

recipes.name: Falafel
steps: Fry onion and garlic in 1 tbsp oil 5 min until soft.
Mash with chickpeas and spices, stir in parsley and seasoning, add egg.
Shape into 6 balls, flatten into patties.
Fry in remaining oil 3 min each side until golden.
Serve hot or cold with couscous, pitta or salad.

recipes.name: Falafel Pita Sandwich with Tahini Sauce
steps: Bake falafel at 450F (230C) 8-10 min until heated through.
Whisk tahini, water, lemon juice, garlic and paprika.
Cut pockets in pitas, fill with 2 falafel, lettuce, tomato, cucumber, pickle, onion.
Drizzle 1 tbsp tahini sauce and harissa into each.

batch.notes: Add the cucumber fresh; it turns watery in storage.

recipes.name: Fårikål (Norwegian National Dish)
steps: Cut lamb into large pieces; slice cabbage into wedges keeping core.
Layer lamb fat-side down with peppercorns, salt and cabbage, ending with cabbage.
Optionally sprinkle flour for a thicker stew.
Add water, boil, cover and simmer low 2-3 hours until lamb falls off bone.
Serve with boiled potatoes, parsley and broth.

recipes.name: Fašírky
steps: Soak bread in milk, squeeze out and mash to crumbs.
Combine pork, onion, garlic, bread, egg and seasonings; mix well.
Shape into palm-sized flattened patties.
Dust with flour, dip in beaten egg, coat in breadcrumbs.
Fry in oil over medium 4-5 min per side until golden; drain.

recipes.name: Fasoliyyeh Bi Z-Zayt (Syrian Green Beans with Olive Oil)
steps: Put green beans in a pot, drizzle with olive oil, season with salt.
Cover and cook over medium-high, stirring, until beans steam and brown.
Add cilantro and garlic, cook just until cilantro wilts.
Serve with warm pita as a main or side.

recipes.name: Fennel Dauphinoise
steps: Heat oven to 180C/160C fan.
Simmer potatoes, fennel and garlic in milk and cream, covered, 10 min until just tender.
Divide into 2 buttered ramekins, scatter with Parmesan.
Bake 40 min until golden and tender.
Snip reserved fennel fronds over before serving.

batch.notes: Cream sauces can separate if frozen; refrigerate and eat by day 3.

recipes.name: Feteer Meshaltet
steps: Knead flour, salt and water into a very elastic dough; rest 10 min, divide into 6-8 balls.
Immerse balls in warm butter/ghee, rest 15-20 min. Heat oven to 550F.
Stretch each ball paper-thin, fold into squares brushing with butter between folds.
Stack folded pieces, press onto a 10-inch dish, brush with butter.
Bake ~10 min, then broil to brown; butter and cover to keep moist.

recipes.name: Fettuccine Alfredo
steps: Cook pasta in boiling salted water.
Heat cream and butter in a skillet over medium until bubbling and melted.
Whisk in parmesan, season with salt and pepper, let thicken.
Toss in pasta until coated; garnish with parsley.

batch.notes: Cream sauces can separate if frozen; refrigerate and eat by day 3.

recipes.name: Fettucine alfredo
steps: Stir clotted cream, butter and cornflour over low heat to a low simmer; keep warm.
Mix cheese, nutmeg and black pepper in a bowl (no salt yet).
Cook pasta in salted water 3-4 min, reserve some water, drain.
Fold pasta into cream, add cheese, splash in 3 tbsp cooking water; stir until glossy.
Season, top with chives or parsley, serve immediately.

batch.notes: Cream sauces can separate if frozen; refrigerate and eat by day 3.

recipes.name: Fish fofos
steps: Poach fish in water 10 min over low heat; drain and flake.
Mix fish with potato, chilli, coriander, cumin, pepper, garlic, ginger, rice flour and 1 egg.
Form into 15 small logs, coat in beaten egg then breadcrumbs; chill 20 min.
Fry in 1cm oil over medium 2 min each side until golden; drain.
Serve with onion-coriander-lemon salad and mango chutney.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Fish pie
steps: Boil potatoes 15 min until tender, drain, mash with 1 tbsp oil and season.
Bring milk and fish to boil, stand 3 min, then flake fish into a dish.
Cook flour in oil 30 sec, stir in reserved milk and cream until thick.
Heat oven to 190C. Add artichokes, leek, prawns, herbs, lemon to fish; pour over sauce.
Top with mash, fork into peaks, sprinkle cheese; bake 35-40 min until golden.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; it does not freeze well.

recipes.name: Fish Soup (Ukha)
steps: Cook onions in olive oil until caramelized, add carrots 4 min until softening.
Add stock, water, potatoes, bay leaves, peppercorns and salt; boil then simmer covered 10 min.
Add millet, cook 15 min until millet and potatoes are done.
Gently add fish cubes, simmer just until opaque and flaking.
Garnish with dill or parsley before serving.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Fish Stew with Rouille
steps: Peel prawns; fry shells in 1 tbsp oil 5 min, add wine, reduce, add stock and strain.
Soften fennel, onion and garlic in oil 10 min; parboil potato chunks 5 min.
Add orange zest, star anise, bay and harissa, fry 5-10 min; stir in tomato puree, tomatoes and stock.
Simmer 10 min; add potato, fish and prawns 3 min, then mussels 2 min until open.
Stir harissa into mayonnaise for rouille; serve stew topped with rouille and bread.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Fiskesuppe (Creamy Norwegian Fish Soup)
steps: Cube fish, chop garlic, cut vegetables into thin strips.
Heat butter, cook garlic until golden, whisk in flour.
Whisk in fish stock until smooth, add vegetables and milk, boil 10 min.
Stir in creme fraiche, simmer, then turn off heat and add fish; let sit 5 min.
Add shrimp just before serving; sprinkle with chives.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Flamiche
steps: Blitz flour, salt, butter and lard to crumbs, stir in cheese and water; line a 23cm tin and chill 20 min.
Cook leeks in 75g butter, covered, 10 min, then uncovered until liquid evaporates; cool.
Heat oven to 200C. Blind bake case 15-20 min, remove beans, bake 7-10 min more until crisp.
Beat creme fraiche, egg, yolks and nutmeg; season, stir in leeks.
Pour into case, bake at 190C 35-40 min until set and golden; rest 10 min.

recipes.name: Flija Layered Pancake / Crepe
steps: Mix flour, water and salt into a thick but pourable batter; set aside.
Mix butter, oil and yogurt/cream into a runny custard-like filling; rest 10 min.
Oil a deep tray, pipe flour batter in a star pattern, grill 3-5 min until golden.
Brush with filling, add another star layer of batter, grill 3-5 min; repeat ~2 hours.
Fill gaps every few layers; serve straight away with honey or yogurt.

recipes.name: French Lentils With Garlic and Thyme
steps: Heat oil in a saucepan, saute chopped vegetables 5-10 min until softened.
Add 6 cups water, lentils, thyme, bay leaves and salt; boil then fast simmer.
Simmer 20-25 min until tender and most water absorbed; drain any excess.
For richer flavor use chicken stock in place of some water. Serve or cool and reheat.

recipes.name: French Omelette
steps: Warm a 20cm non-stick pan over medium. Beat eggs lightly, season with Parmesan, salt and pepper.
Melt a knob of butter until sizzling, pour in eggs.
Draw mixture in from the sides into folds, stir lightly to combine cooked and raw egg.
Shake pan flat to settle; a burst of heat browns the underside.
Tilt pan, fold omelette over and tip onto a plate; glaze with remaining butter, serve at once.

batch.notes: Reheat to 165 °F; eggs turn rubbery if frozen.

recipes.name: French Onion Chicken with Roasted Carrots & Mashed Potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 425F. Cut carrots, dice potatoes, thinly slice onion.
Toss carrots with oil, salt, pepper; roast 15-20 min. Boil potatoes 12-15 min until tender, drain.
Cook onion in oil 8-10 min, add sugar, stock concentrate and water; cook 2-3 min until jammy.
Season chicken, sear in oil 5-6 min per side; top with onion and cheese, cover to melt.
Mash potatoes with sour cream, butter and seasoning; plate with chicken and carrots.

recipes.name: French Onion Soup
steps: Melt butter with oil, fry onions covered 10 min, add sugar and cook 20 min until caramelised.
Add garlic near the end, stir in flour.
Raise heat, gradually add wine then hot stock; cover and simmer 15-20 min.
Toast bread, ladle soup into heatproof bowls, top with toast and cheese.
Grill until melted and serve.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Fresh sardines
steps: Wash the fish under cold water.
Roll in flour and deep fry in oil until crispy.
Drain on kitchen towel to remove excess oil.
Serve hot or cold with a slice of lemon.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Fried calamari
steps: Cut squid into ½cm rings. Season flour in a bag with capers, add squid and shake to coat.
Mix garlic and mayonnaise for the dip.
Heat oil ~7cm deep until a bread piece sizzles.
Fry squid in batches ~3 min until crisp; drain on kitchen paper.
Serve straight away with the mayonnaise and lemon wedges.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; it does not freeze well.

recipes.name: Fruit and Cream Cheese Breakfast Pastries
steps: Heat oven to 400F (200C), line two sheets with parchment. Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla.
Roll out puff pastry, cut each sheet into 9 squares, cut an L shape near two opposite corners.
Fold one cut corner over to the opposite corner to form a diamond.
Add 1-2 tsp cream cheese filling and berries to the center of each.
Bake 15-20 min until golden and puffed.

recipes.name: Ful Medames
steps: Simmer drained beans in unsalted water, covered, 2-2½ hours until tender, salting once softened.
Reduce the liquid; mash a ladle or two of beans with liquid and stir back to thicken.
Serve in bowls sprinkled with parsley and Arab bread.
Pass olive oil, lemon quarters, salt, pepper, garlic, chili flakes and cumin for dressing.
Optionally top with hard-boiled egg or cucumber-tomato salad.

recipes.name: Full English Breakfast
steps: Heat an oiled grill plate on low. Cook sausages slowly 15-20 min, then raise heat to medium.
Fry bacon 2-4 min per side; cook mushrooms 4-6 min and tomatoes cut-side down 4-5 min.
Fry black pudding slices 1½-2 min each side until crisp.
Fry bread in a separate oiled pan 2-3 min per side, then fry eggs in it, basting with butter.
Serve everything on warm plates with ketchup or brown sauce.

recipes.name: Imam bayildi with BBQ lamb & tzatziki
steps: Heat oven to 190C; halve aubergines, score, brush with oil and roast 20 min until soft.
Fry onion with garlic and cinnamon; add scooped aubergine flesh and tomatoes, cook 10 min, add parsley.
Fill aubergine halves with tomato mix, drizzle oil and bake 30 min until collapsed.
Mix tzatziki ingredients and chill in a serving bowl.
Season lamb, griddle 3 min per side, squeeze lemon; serve with aubergines and tzatziki.

batch.notes: Add the cucumber fresh; it turns watery in storage.

recipes.name: Irish stew
steps: Heat oven to 180C; simmer soaked wheat in water about 1 hr until cooked, then drain.
Season lamb and sear in oil in batches 4 min until browned; set aside.
Fry shallots then remaining veg in oil until browned; set aside with lamb.
Add wine, sugar, herbs and seasoning; boil 3 min to reduce by half.
Return lamb, veg and wheat with stock; boil 5 min, then braise in oven 1.5 hrs.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Jajek
steps: Process yogurt, water, garlic and salt in a food processor for a few seconds.
Transfer to a bowl and mix in the mint and cucumber.
Chill for a few hours and serve cold, adding ice cubes when serving.

batch.notes: Add the cucumber fresh; it turns watery in storage.

recipes.name: Jamaican Beef Patties
steps: Mix flour, salt and turmeric, rub in shortening, add ice water to a dough; chill 30 min.
Season beef with allspice and pepper; saute onion, pepper, garlic and thyme, add beef.
Stir in ketchup and water, simmer to a thick sauce, fold in green onions and cool.
Fill 5-inch dough circles, fold, crimp with a fork and brush with egg wash.
Bake at 350F for 30 minutes until golden; cool on racks.

recipes.name: Jamaican Boiled Dumplings
steps: Bring salted water to a boil in a large pot.
Combine flour and salt, gradually add water and mix by hand into a dough.
Divide into balls and flatten each into a thick round disk.
Drop dumplings into boiling water and boil 15-20 minutes until risen and cooked.
Remove with a slotted spoon, draining excess water, and serve.

recipes.name: Jamaican Cornmeal Porridge
steps: Bring 2 1/2 cups water and 1 can coconut milk to a boil in a heavy pot.
Whisk 1 cup cornmeal with 1 1/2 cups water until smooth.
Whisk cornmeal mixture into the pot for 1 minute until no lumps remain.
Cover and cook on low 15-20 minutes; stir in vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg and allspice.
Remove from heat, sweeten with condensed milk and serve.

recipes.name: Jamaican Curry Chicken Recipe
steps: Season chicken with seasoning, curry powder, onion, peppers, garlic and thyme; marinate 1 hr+.
Remove aromatics, then heat oil and bloom remaining curry powder 20-30 seconds.
Saute onion, pepper, garlic and thyme 3-5 minutes until softened.
Add chicken and 1/4 cup water, cover and cook 30-35 minutes on medium-low.
Stir in potato for the last 15 minutes; cook until tender, season and serve.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Jamaican Curry Goat
steps: Rinse goat with vinegar; season with curry powder, seasoning, ginger, allspice and thyme.
Marinate 4+ hours, then brown goat in oil in a pressure cooker 2-3 min per side.
Bloom remaining curry powder, saute onion and garlic, then return goat with water.
Pressure cook 40 minutes on high, then natural release 10 minutes.
Saute with potatoes and a scotch bonnet until potatoes soften; remove pepper and serve.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Jamaican Curry Shrimp Recipe
steps: Season shrimp with curry powder and all-purpose seasoning; rest 10 minutes.
Heat 2 Tbsp oil and saute onion, bell peppers, scotch bonnet and garlic 5 minutes.
Stir in 1.5 Tbsp curry powder for 1 minute.
Add coconut milk, shrimp, ketchup and thyme; simmer 5-6 minutes until shrimp cooks.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Jamaican Festival (Sweet Dumpling)
steps: Heat 3 inches of oil to 350F in a heavy pot or deep fryer.
Combine flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Add vanilla and milk, stir, and form into a dough ball.
Pinch off pieces and roll into long ovals, making about 12 dumplings.
Fry at 350F on all sides 4-6 minutes until golden; drain and serve.

recipes.name: Jamaican Fried Dumplings
steps: Combine flour, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
Pour in milk, stir and knead into a dough, then form about 10 balls.
Heat oil in a 10-inch skillet to about 350F over medium heat.
Fry dumplings until browned on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels and serve.

batch.notes: The coating softens in storage; re-crisp in the oven or an air fryer.

recipes.name: Jamaican Instant Pot Rice and Beans
steps: Saute onion in olive oil in the Instant Pot 3 minutes; add garlic and green onions 30 sec.
Cancel, then stir in rice, coconut milk, water, salt, allspice and pepper.
Top with undrained kidney beans and thyme sprigs; do not stir.
Seal and pressure cook on High for 6 minutes.
Natural release 10 minutes, quick release, remove thyme and fluff with a fork.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Jamaican Pepper Shrimp
steps: Toss shrimp with scotch bonnet, seasoning, annatto and allspice; marinate 10 minutes.
Heat a pan, add shrimp stock and bring to a gentle simmer.
Stir in onion and garlic and cook about 2 minutes until softened.
Add shrimp and thyme, cover and cook 5-7 minutes until bright orange.
Stir in vinegar, cook 1 minute, salt to taste and serve with liquid.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Jamaican Rice and Peas
steps: Stir rice, coconut milk, kidney beans, water, salt, allspice and pepper in a pot.
Top with green onions, thyme and scotch bonnet, then bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover and cook 18 minutes.
Rest covered off the heat 5 minutes.
Remove aromatics, fluff with a fork and serve.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Jamaican Steamed Cabbage
steps: Add all ingredients to a large pan and cover with a lid.
Cook on medium heat 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Reduce to low and cook 5 more minutes until cabbage is tender.
Remove thyme stalks and serve.

recipes.name: Jamon & wild garlic croquetas
steps: Wilt wild garlic with boiling water, rinse cold, squeeze dry and finely chop.
Warm the milk; cook flour in oil or butter, then whisk in milk to a thick sauce.
Beat in manchego, jamon and wild garlic; spread out and chill at least 1 hour.
Shape into 18-20 balls and freeze 30 minutes to firm up.
Coat in egg and panko, then fry at 170C for 2-3 minutes until golden; drain.

recipes.name: Japanese gohan rice
steps: Rinse rice in cold water, massaging and draining repeatedly until the water stays clear.
Add rice to a pan with 400ml water (or dashi and water) and bring to a boil.
Reduce to a low simmer, cover and cook 15 minutes.
Off the heat, rest 15 minutes, then stir through the mirin.
Fluff and serve with optional toppings.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Japanese Katsudon
steps: Fry sliced onion in oil until golden, then set the tonkatsu in the middle of the pan.
Mix dashi, soy, mirin and sugar; pour three-quarters around the tonkatsu.
Sizzle a few minutes to thicken the sauce and reheat the tonkatsu.
Pour beaten eggs around and cook 2-3 minutes until just set.
Serve over rice in bowls, topped with chives and extra soy.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Jerk chicken with rice & peas
steps: Blend all marinade ingredients with 1 tsp salt into a thick puree.
Slash chicken thighs, rub with marinade and refrigerate overnight.
Roast chicken with lime halves at 180C/160C fan/gas 4 for 45 minutes.
Rinse rice, add remaining ingredients except beans and 300ml water; boil then cover 10 min.
Stir in beans, rest off heat 5 minutes, then serve with the chicken.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Jiggs Dinner
steps: The night before, soak salt beef and split peas in water overnight (8-10 hours).
Drain beef, cover with fresh water in a stockpot, and add peas in a tied cloth bag.
Bring to a boil, then simmer 2 hours; remove peas bag and mash with butter and pepper.
Add cabbage and boil 20 minutes, then add turnip, carrots and potatoes.
Boil 20 more minutes until tender; serve meat and veg with the pot liquor.

recipes.name: kabse
steps: Caramelize chicken in olive oil with a stock cube, then boil about 30 minutes.
Saute all the vegetables in another pot until soft.
Add rice, raisins and spices with 2.5 cups water and cook the rice.
Transfer everything to the oven to finish.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Kadu Borani
steps: Peel and cut squash into 1cm pieces; deep-fry until golden and set aside.
In the same oil, deep-fry onions until golden, then grind with garlic.
Fry turmeric in oil, add salted water, then layer squash with onion-garlic; repeat.
Add sugar and a cup of water; simmer until reduced.
Serve topped with yogurt and green chilli.

recipes.name: Kafteji
steps: Peel and cube potatoes; fry in hot olive oil until golden, about 20 minutes, then drain.
Grill oiled peppers until skins blister, bag 15 minutes, then peel.
Fry sliced onions until golden, adding ras el hanout at the end.
Fry cubed pumpkin 10-15 minutes until soft, then drain.
Combine all veg, pour in whisked eggs, cover to set, then chop and season.

recipes.name: Kapsalon
steps: Cut doner meat into strips and fry in oil about 6 minutes until cooked.
Deep-fry fries until golden and spread across a baking dish.
Top fries with the meat, then a layer of cheese; oven-bake until melted.
Mix chopped lettuce, tomato and cucumber into a salad.
Spread salad over the dish and serve with garlic sauce and hot sauce.

batch.notes: Add the cucumber fresh; it turns watery in storage.

recipes.name: Karbonader (Lean Beef Patties) with Caramelized Onions
steps: Slice onions and fry in butter over low heat until caramelized; grate extra onion aside.
Mix ground beef with grated onion, salt, pepper, nutmeg, cornstarch and water.
Form a sausage, cut 6 patties and score a grid into each.
Brown patties in butter on high, then fry 2-3 minutes on low.
Serve with potatoes, peas and brown sauce.

recipes.name: Kaspressknödel - Cheese Dumplings
steps: Mix cubed bread with milk, season with salt, and let rest.
Add shredded potatoes, grated cheese, eggs and parsley.
Fry cubed onion in butter until golden and stir into the mixture.
Add flour, knead, shape flat dumplings and fry both sides in butter until golden.
Serve in clear broth.

recipes.name: Katsu Chicken curry
steps: Soften onion and garlic in oil, add carrots and cook 10-12 minutes on low.
Stir in flour and curry powder, add stock, honey, soy and bay; simmer 20 minutes.
Strain sauce, stir in garam masala and keep warm.
Coat pounded chicken in flour, egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry chicken 3-4 minutes per side until golden; slice and serve with sauce and rice.

batch.notes: The coating softens in storage; re-crisp in the oven or an air fryer.

recipes.name: Kedgeree
steps: Fry onion in oil 5 minutes, add spices and cook until browned and fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Stir in rice, add 600ml water, boil then cover and simmer 10 minutes; rest 10-15 minutes.
Poach haddock with bay in milk 10 minutes, then skin and flake.
Boil eggs 4.5-5 minutes, cool, peel and quarter.
Gently mix fish, eggs, herbs and rice; serve hot.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Kelem dolmasi
steps: Boil rice 8 minutes; chop onion and herbs, and roughly chop chickpeas.
Mix minced lamb and fat with onion, spices, chickpeas, rice and herbs; season.
Blanch whole cabbage 3-4 minutes, peel off leaves, trim stalks and halve large ones.
Spoon filling onto each leaf and roll tightly like small burritos.
Line a pot with spare leaves, add rolls and water, weight down, simmer 25 min; add tomato sauce.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Keleya Zaara
steps: Brown lamb in oil about 5 minutes; season with saffron, salt and pepper.
Add most of the onion and water, cover and simmer about 15 minutes until tender.
Uncover, stir in butter and reduce sauce 5-10 minutes.
Serve topped with remaining onion, parsley and lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Kentucky Fried Chicken
steps: Preheat fryer to 350F and mix all the spices together.
Combine spice mix with flour, brown sugar and salt.
Dip chicken in egg white, then coat firmly in the flour mixture; rest 5 minutes.
Fry in batches 12-14 minutes until it reaches 165F internal.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.

batch.notes: The coating softens in storage; re-crisp in the oven or an air fryer.

recipes.name: Kenyan Beef Curry
steps: Simmer beef with garlic and ginger in 4 cups water 20 minutes; drain, reserving liquid.
Soften onions in oil 5-7 minutes, add tomatoes and cook until falling apart.
Stir in beef, then paprika, pepper, curry powder, tomato paste and salt.
Add reserved water to cover, simmer uncovered about 1 hour until tender and thick.
Garnish with fresh chilli and cilantro.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Khobz el Dar (Algerian Semolina Bread)
steps: Mix semolina, sesame, sugar, yeast and salt; whisk in oil and eggs, then warm milk.
Cover and let stand about 1 hour until frothy.
Stir in flour to a sticky dough and rest 30 minutes.
Shape into a round loaf and let rise about 1 hour until doubled.
Brush with egg wash, sprinkle sesame and bake at 400F for 20-25 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Kidney Bean Curry
steps: Soften onion with salt in oil, then add garlic, ginger and coriander stalks 2 minutes.
Add spices and cook 1 minute, then tip in tomatoes and kidney beans with their water; boil.
Simmer 15 minutes until thick, season and serve with basmati rice.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: kofta burgers
steps: Mix mince with onion, garlic, garam masala, coriander, chilli sauce and salt by hand.
Shape into 16 small burgers (freeze or chill ahead if you like).
Grill on highest setting 5-6 minutes per side until browned and cooked through.
Serve in pita with tomato, cabbage, onion and yogurt.

recipes.name: Koshari
steps: Boil lentils 15-17 minutes until just tender; drain and lightly salt.
Combine lentils and rice with oil and spices, add water to cover and simmer about 20 minutes.
Cook macaroni until al dente and drain; warm the chickpeas.
Toss onion rings in salt and flour, fry until crisp and caramelized, 15-20 minutes.
Layer rice-lentils, pasta and chickpeas, and top with crispy onions.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Koulenje
steps: Sift flour, baking powder, salt and sugar; beat 6 eggs with butter and milk.
Add mahleb and black seeds, make a well, pour in wet mix and stir to a dough.
Knead gently, roll 1/2 inch thick and cut into shapes; prick with a fork.
Brush with beaten egg and extra black seeds.
Bake at 400F for 12-15 minutes until golden; best eaten warm.

recipes.name: Kulaç Soda Bread
steps: Mix flour, baking soda and salt, make a well and add yogurt.
Combine and knead into a slightly sticky, pizza-like dough.
Oil a tray, shape dough into a circle about 5cm high and coat with olive oil.
Score patterns with a fork for even cooking.
Bake on the bottom shelf about 40 minutes until golden; cool before slicing.

recipes.name: Kumpir
steps: Bake the potatoes until soft.
Mash plenty of butter into the potato, then top with grated cheese.
Mix grated cheese with finely chopped onion, red pepper, salt, pepper and chilli flakes.
Add toppings of choice like sweetcorn, olives and salad and serve.

recipes.name: Kung Pao Chicken
steps: Mix sake, soy, sesame oil and cornstarch-water; divide in half.
Marinate chicken in half the mixture and refrigerate 30 minutes.
In a pan heat remaining sauce with chilli, vinegar and sugar, then add onion, garlic, chestnuts, peanuts.
Saute the marinated chicken separately until juices run clear.
Combine chicken with the sauce and simmer until thickened.

recipes.name: Kung Po Prawns
