steps: Toss prawns in cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy; rest 10 minutes.
Mix vinegar, remaining soy, tomato puree, sugar and water into a sauce.
Fry prawns in hot oil until golden, then remove.
Fry peanuts, chillies and chestnuts, add ginger and garlic 1 minute.
Return prawns with sauce, simmer 2 minutes until thickened; serve with rice.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Lakra me Mish Cabbage and Meat Stew
steps: Fry onions, diced beef and red peppers in olive oil for 5 minutes until the meat is browned.
Stir in paprika, tomato puree and chilli flakes, season, and fry 2 minutes.
Add the cabbage and boiling water, stir, and simmer until tender.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Lakror me Kungull Summer Squash Pie
steps: Mix squash, sugar, eggs and baking soda, then add flour to form a thick sticky batter.
Oil a round baking tray and spread the mixture evenly across it.
Drizzle a little olive oil over the top and bake until set and golden.

recipes.name: Laksa King Prawn Noodles
steps: Cook chilli in oil 1 min, then add curry paste and cook 1 min more.
Add 700ml stock and the coconut milk, bring to the boil, then season with fish sauce.
Add noodles and cook 3-4 mins, then stir in lime juice and prawns until heated through.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Lamb & apricot meatballs
steps: Soften onions in oil 5 mins, add garlic and spices, then reserve half for the meatballs.
Add tomatoes, sugar and seasoning to the pan and simmer about 10 mins into a sauce.
Mix reserved onions with mint, lamb, apricots and breadcrumbs and shape into meatballs.
Brown the meatballs and simmer them in the tomato sauce until cooked through.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Lamb and Lemon Souvlaki
steps: Pound garlic with sea salt into a paste and whisk with oil, lemon juice, zest and dill.
Coat the lamb in the marinade and chill at least 2 hrs or overnight.
Thread the lamb onto soaked skewers and grill until charred and cooked through.
Serve in warmed pita bread.

recipes.name: Lamb and Potato pie
steps: Dust the lamb with flour, then fry with onion in oil until browned and season.
Add carrots and stock, boil, cover and simmer at least 1 hour until the meat is tender.
Top with potatoes and shortcrust pastry and glaze with egg.
Bake until the pastry is golden.

recipes.name: Lamb Biryani
steps: Grind cashews, poppy and cumin seeds into a smooth paste.
Deep-fry sliced onions until light brown, then fry cashews until golden, and drain.
Wash the basmati rice and soak 20 minutes.
Cook lamb with spices and yogurt, layer with rice and saffron milk, and dum-cook.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Lamb Pilaf (Plov)
steps: Soak raisins and prunes with lemon juice 1 hr, then drain and chop the prunes.
Cook onion in butter 5 mins, add cubed and ground lamb with garlic, fry 5 mins until browned.
Add stock and rice with saffron, then simmer until the rice is tender.
Stir through the dried fruit and parsley to serve.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Lamb Rogan josh
steps: Blitz the onions, then fry with a lid until golden and soft.
Add garlic and ginger, fry 5 mins, then stir in madras paste, spices, bay and tomato puree.
Add the lamb and 300ml water, then simmer until the meat is tender.
Stir through Greek yogurt and coriander to finish.

recipes.name: Lamb Tagine
steps: Soften onion and carrot in olive oil 3-4 mins.
Brown the diced lamb, then add garlic and spices and cook until aromatic.
Add honey, apricots, stock cube and about 500ml boiling water, and bring to the boil.
Simmer until the lamb is tender, then serve with couscous and parsley.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Lamb tomato and sweet spices
steps: Drain pickled vine leaves, blanch in boiling water 10 mins, and pat dry.
Cook lamb mince with onion, ginger, garlic, tomatoes and sweet spices into a filling.
Roll the filling in the vine leaves and arrange in a pan.
Serve with buttered basmati rice.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Lamb Tzatziki Burgers
steps: Boil the bulgur wheat 10 mins, then drain well.
Make tzatziki by mixing grated cucumber, yogurt, mint and salt.
Combine bulgur with lamb, spices and garlic, then shape into 4 burgers.
Brush with oil and fry or barbecue, serving in buns with tzatziki.

batch.notes: Add the cucumber fresh; it turns watery in storage.

recipes.name: Lancashire hotpot
steps: Heat oven to 160C/fan 140C and brown the lamb and kidneys in batches in dripping.
Fry onions and carrots until golden, add flour, Worcestershire sauce and stock, and boil.
Return the meat and bay leaves, then top with sliced potatoes.
Cover and bake, uncovering near the end to crisp the potatoes.

recipes.name: Lao Naem Khao
steps: Soak thinly sliced onion and shallots in ice water.
Mix grated coconut with jasmine rice and form into 2-inch croquette balls.
Dip the rice balls in beaten egg and deep-fry until crisp.
Crumble the fried rice, toss with sour pork, herbs and peanuts, and serve in lettuce.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Lasagna Sandwiches
steps: Mix sour cream, onion, oregano and salt, then spread on four bread slices.
Layer with bacon, tomato and mozzarella, then top with the remaining bread.
Melt butter in a skillet and toast the sandwiches until golden and the cheese melts.

batch.notes: Pack the parts separately; assemble when you eat.

recipes.name: Lasagne
steps: Cook bacon in oil until golden, add onion, celery and carrot and soften 5 mins.
Add garlic and minced beef, browning and breaking up the meat.
Stir in tomato puree, chopped tomatoes and honey, then simmer into a ragu.
Layer ragu, lasagne sheets and creme fraiche, top with cheeses and bake.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Leblebi Soup
steps: Cook the onion in oil until translucent.
Add the soaked chickpeas and stock, then simmer covered 30 mins.
Toast and grind cumin, then pound with garlic and salt into a paste.
Stir the paste and harissa into the soup, simmer, and finish with lime.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Leg of Lamb Armenian-Style
steps: Combine all ingredients in a roasting pan and marinate up to two days, stirring occasionally.
Bake at 350F for 1 to 1½ hours until the meat is no longer red when sliced.
Alternatively, thread onto skewers and grill.

recipes.name: Lemongrass beef stew with noodles
steps: Blitz ginger, garlic, lemongrass, coriander and chilli into a paste.
Cook the paste in oil 5 mins over low heat.
Add beef, soy, five-spice, sugar and stock, then simmer covered 1 hr 15 mins.
Uncover and cook 15 mins more until tender, then serve over rice noodles with lime.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Locro
steps: Soak the corn and beans overnight.
Brown the beef and pork, then add onions and spices until translucent.
Add corn, beans, pumpkin, potato and enough water to cover.
Simmer 2-3 hours until thick, and serve hot with bread.

recipes.name: Ma Po Tofu
steps: Cube tofu and blanch in salted boiling water 1 minute, then drain.
Fry minced beef in oil until crispy; remove, then fry doubanjiang, garlic, ginger and black beans.
Add water, soy sauce, beef and tofu; simmer 6-8 minutes.
Stir in cornstarch slurry to thicken, add garlic greens and Sichuan pepper.
Serve immediately with steamed rice.

recipes.name: Mango chow
steps: Chop mango, spring onions and scotch bonnet; add coriander.
Add lime zest and juice; season with salt and pepper.
Combine everything in a bowl and serve alongside anything.

recipes.name: Mantu Afghan Dumpling
steps: Make stiff dough from flour, salt and water; knead 5-10 min and rest 1 hour.
Mix chopped lamb, onions, chilli, salt and spices for the filling.
Roll dough thin, cut 10cm squares, fill and pinch corners, leaving small gaps.
Steam over medium heat 30-45 minutes.
Simmer tomato puree sauce; top dumplings with sauce, yoghurt and coriander.

recipes.name: Massaman Beef curry
steps: Roast peanuts at 200C for 5 minutes, then chop; reduce oven to 180C.
Fry curry paste in coconut cream, add beef and seal.
Add remaining coconut, water, potatoes, onion, lime leaves, cinnamon, tamarind, sugar, fish sauce.
Cover and cook in oven 2 hours until beef is tender.
Top with chilli and remaining peanuts; serve with jasmine rice.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Mastawa Lamb and Rice
steps: Simmer lamb pieces with onions and turmeric in water until very tender.
Shred meat off the bones and return to the pan.
Add washed rice and salt; cook uncovered until al dente and liquid absorbed.
Stir in yoghurt, then garlic fried in oil, dill, pepper and chickpeas.
Cover with a cloth and lid; rest on low heat 30 minutes. Serve with naan.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Matambre a la Pizza
steps: Season steak with salt and pepper; grill one side until half-cooked.
Spread tomato sauce on cooked side, then add cheese, oregano and olives.
Grill until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Slice and serve hot.

recipes.name: Matar Paneer
steps: Fry paneer in hot oil until browned on all sides; drain.
Fry ginger, cumin, turmeric, coriander and chilli 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, mash and simmer 5 minutes; season.
Add peas, simmer 2 minutes, then stir in paneer and garam masala.
Top with coriander; serve with naan, roti or rice.

recipes.name: Mbuzi Choma (Roasted Goat)
steps: Roast goat meat over medium heat 50 minutes, salting as you turn it.
For ugali, boil salted water and stir in cornmeal slowly.
Stir 10 minutes until thick and pulling from the pan; cool and shape.
Mix tomatoes, onions, chilli and coriander for kachumbari.
Serve meat with ugali and kachumbari.

recipes.name: McSinghs Scotch pie
steps: Toast cumin; fry onion, garlic, chilli, pepper 8 min, then add spices and cool.
Mix minced lamb with white pepper, coriander and the spiced onions; chill.
Heat oven to 200C/400F; make hot-water pastry with flour, milk, lard and water.
Line greased tin with pastry, fill, top with a lid and vent.
Brush with egg yolk; bake 30 min, then 1 1/4 hours at 160C. Cool before serving.

recipes.name: Meang Nem
steps: Toast soaked rice until dark golden, about 5 min, then grind and sift into powder.
Chop shallots, galangal, pickled scallion, chilli and orange zest; toast coconut 2-3 min.
Mix lime juice, orange juice, palm sugar, scallion brine and fish sauce for dressing.
Combine dried shrimp, coconut, aromatics and dressing; stir in rice powder and peanuts.
Serve for guests to wrap in leafy greens and eat in bites.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Pasta Salad
steps: Boil farfalle in salted water about 10 minutes; drain and cool under cold water.
Quarter tomatoes, slice olives, tear basil into a salad bowl with olive oil.
Toss pasta with tomatoes and basil.
Add olives, mozzarella balls and tuna; rest 30 minutes.
Grind black pepper and drizzle olive oil before serving.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Mee goreng mamak
steps: Fry peanuts, dried chilli, shrimp and dhal until fragrant; blend with tamarind and water.
Saute the paste in oil until the oil separates and it darkens.
Boil potato chunks until tender; slice tofu, onion, cabbage and prawn fritters.
Stir-fry garlic, onion and paste, then add tofu, potato, veg and fritters.
Add noodles and dark soy mixture, stir in an egg; garnish with lime and chilli.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Migas
steps: Crumble bread, sprinkle with water, cover and rest 30 minutes.
Fry unpeeled slit garlic cloves in olive oil 5 minutes; set aside.
Simmer bread in the oil, stirring constantly 15 minutes, with black pepper.
Return garlic and stir about 20 minutes until bread is soft and golden.

recipes.name: Milanesa
steps: Season cutlets with salt and pepper.
Dip in egg, then coat with breadcrumbs, parsley and garlic.
Fry in oil over medium heat 3-4 minutes per side until golden.
Serve hot with lemon wedges or a side salad.

recipes.name: Minced Beef Pie
steps: Heat oven to 200C/400F. Fry beef mince 4-5 minutes until browned.
Add onion, tomato puree and flour, then mushrooms, stock and Worcestershire.
Simmer 20 minutes; cool and turn into a pie dish.
Top with rolled pastry, decorate, vent and brush with egg yolk.
Bake 20-25 minutes until golden-brown; slice to serve.

recipes.name: Mini chilli beef pies
steps: Fry onion 5 min, add spices, beef, tomato puree, stock and cinnamon.
Simmer 15-20 min, adding beans near the end; cool.
Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C. Line muffin tray with pastry circles, bake 10 min.
Boil and mash potato with soured cream, seasoning and chives.
Fill cases with chilli and mash; bake 15 min until golden.

recipes.name: Molasses Baked Beans
steps: Soak dried beans overnight in a Dutch oven.
Drain, cover with water and cook 30 minutes until just tender; reserve liquid.
Heat oven to 325F/160C. Brown pork, then cook onion until tender.
Add beans, molasses, brown sugar, vinegar, mustard, seasoning and bean water.
Bake uncovered 3 to 5 hours until tender and the sauce thickens.

recipes.name: Montreal Smoked Meat
steps: Mix cure of salts, pepper, coriander, sugar, bay and cloves; coat brisket.
Cure in fridge 4 days, flipping twice daily; rinse and soak 2 hours.
Rub with pepper, coriander, paprika, garlic, onion, dill, mustard and spices.
Smoke at 225F, fat up, until internal 165F, about 6 hours.
Steam covered until 180F, 1-2 hours; slice and serve on rye with mustard.

recipes.name: Moroccan Carrot Soup
steps: Preheat oven to 180C.
Mix carrots, onion, garlic, cumin, coriander, salt and oil; spread on a tray.
Roast 10-12 minutes until carrots soften, then cool.
Grind with water into a smooth paste and strain.
Heat with 2 cups water, add garam masala, salt and lemon juice; serve hot.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Moussaka
steps: Heat grill to high. Brown beef in an ovenproof pan 5 minutes.
Prick aubergine and microwave on High 3-5 minutes until soft.
Mix yogurt, egg and parmesan; season.
Stir tomatoes, puree and potatoes into beef; top with sliced aubergine.
Pour over yogurt mixture and grill until set and golden.

recipes.name: Mulukhiyah
steps: Saute onions in olive oil, add beef and sear 3-4 minutes each side.
Add water to cover and cook until the meat is done.
Stir in frozen mulukhiyah until thawed and boiling.
Fry garlic in olive oil until fragrant, stir into stew; simmer 5-10 min.
Season with salt; serve with lemon juice and rice or pita.

recipes.name: Muraba-E-Kadu (Pumpkin Jam)
steps: Peel and deseed pumpkin; cut flesh into 2cm cubes.
Zest oranges into matchsticks and juice them; reserve cardamom seeds.
Combine pumpkin, juice, zest, sugar and cardamom; marinate 10 hours.
Boil, then simmer about 1 hour until thick and syrupy.
Cool and store in clean, dry jars.

recipes.name: Mushroom & Chestnut Rotolo
steps: Soak dried mushrooms in boiling water; blitz most chestnuts with water into cream.
Fry shallots, garlic, chopped chestnuts, rosemary and mushrooms with soy sauce.
Whisk wine, mushroom liquid and chestnut cream; add half to pan and cook 1 min.
Heat oven to 180C. Blanch lasagne sheets 2 min, fill, roll and cut.
Top rolls with sauce, bake 10 min, add breadcrumbs and sage, bake 10 min more.

batch.notes: Cook the pasta 1–2 min short; it softens on reheating.

recipes.name: Mushroom soup with buckwheat
steps: Chop onion and garlic, slice mushrooms and wash buckwheat.
Saute onion in oil, then add mushrooms and garlic.
Add salt, stock, buckwheat and bay leaf; cover with water and simmer gently.
Just before done, stir in pepper, sour cream with flour, parsley and vinegar.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Mustard champ
steps: Boil potatoes 15 minutes until tender; drain and mash.
Heat milk and half the butter, then beat into the mash with mustard.
Fry spring onions in remaining butter 2 minutes until just soft.
Fold onions into the mash and serve.

recipes.name: Mutabbaq
steps: Fry garlic and ginger, add minced meat and seasoning; cook and cool.
Mix cooled meat with egg, chopped tomato and spring onion.
Brush filo with butter, add filling and fold into parcels.
Fry parcels until golden on all sides, or bake at 180C for 10-15 minutes.
Serve warm.

recipes.name: Nasi lemak
steps: Simmer coconut milk, water, ginger, bay and rice, covered, 20-30 min until cooked.
Boil eggs, stand 10-12 min, then peel and halve; slice cucumber.
Fry peanuts then anchovies in oil until crisp; drain and discard oil.
Fry onion, garlic, shallots, add chilli paste 10 min, then anchovies, salt, sugar, tamarind; simmer.
Serve sauce over rice topped with peanuts, anchovies, cucumber and eggs.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; it does not freeze well.

recipes.name: Noodle bowl salad
steps: Cover noodles with boiling water, add sugar snaps, soak 4 min, then drain and cool.
Toss noodles in sesame oil.
Mix the dressing ingredients.
Pile spring onions, coriander and salmon on the noodles, add dressing and toss.
Serve with a pretzel or bread roll.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Norwegian Potato Lefse
steps: Boil, peel and rice the warm potatoes twice; cool uncovered in the fridge.
Stir salt, sugar, melted butter and cream into the riced potatoes.
Add flour, knead lightly and divide into 7-12 pieces.
Roll each into a thin circle and cook on a hot griddle, flipping when browned.
Store cooked lefse in a folded damp cloth.

batch.notes: Cream sauces can separate if frozen; refrigerate and eat by day 3.

recipes.name: Num E (Sticky Rice Balls in Sugar Syrup and Coconut Cream)
steps: Simmer coconut cream with pandan, brown sugar, salt and ginger; boil 2 min, then cool.
Blend pandan with water, strain, and knead into 200g sticky rice flour.
Blend beetroot with water, strain, and knead into another 200g flour.
Roll doughs into small balls and boil until they float, then chill in iced water.
Drain and stir balls into the cooled coconut syrup; serve with longan and coconut.

recipes.name: Nutty Chicken Curry
steps: Slice a quarter of the chilli; blitz the rest with ginger, garlic, coriander stalks and leaves.
Brown chicken in oil 1 min, stir in paste 1 min.
Add peanut butter, stock and yogurt; simmer 10 min until chicken is cooked and sauce thick.
Stir in coriander, scatter with chilli, and serve with rice or sweet potato.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Oatmeal pancakes
steps: Blend all the ingredients together.
Let the mixture stand 10 min.
Grease a hot pan with butter and pour a little batter.
Flip when bubbles form; cook over medium-low heat so they don't burn.
Top with caramel and strawberries.

recipes.name: Osso Buco alla Milanese
steps: Heat oven to 300F; dredge seasoned veal shanks in flour, shaking off excess.
Brown shanks in oil and butter about 5 min per side; set aside.
Cook onion, carrot, celery and fennel in butter 6 min; add garlic, zest, marjoram and bay.
Add wine and reduce by half, then stock and tomatoes, reducing to 1 cup.
Braise shanks covered about 2 hrs until tender; finish with gremolata and sauce.

recipes.name: Oxtail with broad beans
steps: Toss oxtail with onion, spring onion, garlic, ginger, chilli, soy, thyme and seasoning.
Brown oxtail in oil about 10 min, then pressure cook with 375ml water 25 min.
Add broad beans and pimento; bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
Stir in cornflour slurry and cook until sauce thickens and beans are tender.

recipes.name: Pa Amb Tomaquet (Bread with Tomato)
steps: Toast bread slices in a toaster or 400F oven until crispy and golden.
Rub the cut side of a garlic clove all over each slice.
Rub a tomato half over the bread, then drizzle with olive oil.
Sprinkle with salt and serve immediately while warm.

recipes.name: Pad See Ew
steps: Mix the sauce ingredients in a small bowl.
Stir-fry garlic, chicken and broccoli stems in oil over high heat until golden.
Push aside, crack in egg and scramble.
Add noodles, broccoli leaves and sauce; toss until dark and wilted, then serve.

recipes.name: Pad Thai
steps: Soak noodles in boiling water 4 mins, drain and refresh under cold water.
Mix lime juice, cayenne, sugar and fish sauce in a bowl.
Fry prawns in oil, add spring onions and noodles and toss.
Stir in lime mixture, beansprouts, half the peanuts and coriander; cook 1 min.
Serve topped with remaining peanuts, coriander and lime wedges.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Padron peppers
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pan over high heat (or air-fryer at 205C for 3 mins).
Fry peppers, stirring often, for 5 mins until blistered and charred.
Transfer to a plate, season with sea salt and serve.

recipes.name: Paella
steps: Sizzle prawn heads and parsley in oil, add sherry and water; simmer 10 mins for stock.
Steam mussels 3-4 mins until open, strain stock over saffron and reserve mussels.
Fry chorizo, onion and rice, then add saffron stock and simmer.
Arrange prawns and mussels on top, cook until rice is tender, then serve.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Pan-fried hake, white bean & chorizo broth
steps: Simmer beans with garlic, bay and thyme for 30 mins until tender.
Fry bread and chorizo in oil until crisp; set aside.
Cook onion, add paprika, beans and chicken stock; simmer 5-10 mins, stir in parsley.
Pan-fry seasoned hake skin-side down 3-5 mins, flip, then serve on the broth.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; it does not freeze well.

recipes.name: Panang chicken curry (kaeng panang gai)
steps: Pound or blitz chillies, shrimp paste, aromatics, spices and peanuts into a curry paste.
Fry paste in thick coconut milk over medium-high heat 1 min until fragrant.
Add chicken, brown 3-4 mins, then stir in French beans.
Season with fish sauce and sugar, add remaining coconut milk and simmer.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Papas Chorreadas Recipe (Potatoes with Cream and Cheese Sauce)
steps: Boil potatoes with chicken bouillon about 30 mins until tender; drain.
Cook onion and tomatoes in oil and butter 7 mins.
Add garlic powder, cumin, salt and pepper; cook 2 mins.
Stir in cream, cilantro and cheese; cook 3 mins until melted.
Pour sauce over potatoes and serve hot.

batch.notes: Cream sauces can separate if frozen; refrigerate and eat by day 3.

recipes.name: Paracuca (Roasted Peanuts)
steps: Boil peanuts, sugar and water until syrup evaporates, about 10 mins.
Spread peanuts on a greased baking pan and sprinkle with salt.
Bake at 300F for 30-35 mins until dry and lightly browned.
Cool completely, then store in an airtight container.

recipes.name: Pastel de Choclo
steps: Hard-boil eggs 15 mins off heat; peel and chop.
Cook onions, garlic and spices, brown beef, then add chicken, raisins, olives and eggs.
Blend corn with basil, cook with butter, milk and sugar into a thick paste.
Layer meat filling and corn topping in a dish.
Bake at 350F until golden.

recipes.name: Pastel de Papas (Chilean Potato Pie)
steps: Boil potatoes about 20 mins until tender.
Cook onion and garlic, add tomatoes and paste, then brown beef 10 mins.
Stir in cheese, parsley and cayenne; season.
Mash drained potatoes with butter and salt.
Layer meat and mash in a dish and bake at 350F until golden.

recipes.name: Paszteciki (Polish Pasties)
steps: Make dough from flour, salt, egg yolk, egg and butter; chill at least 30 mins.
Saute onion and rutabaga in butter, then grind or chop with cooked beef.
Cook meat mixture until liquid evaporates; cool and bind with egg.
Fill and shape the pastries, then bake until golden.

recipes.name: Patatas bravas
steps: Fry onion 5 mins, add garlic, tomatoes, puree, paprika, chilli and sugar; simmer 10 mins.
Heat oven to 200C; toss dried potatoes in olive oil and seasoning.
Roast potatoes 40-50 mins until crisp and golden.
Spoon tomato sauce over the potatoes and sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.name: Pate Chinois
steps: Boil potatoes until tender, then mash with butter and milk; season.
Preheat oven to 375F; brown onion and meat in butter and season.
Press meat into an 8-inch dish, cover with corn, then mashed potatoes.
Sprinkle with paprika and parsley, bake 30 mins, then broil to finish.

batch.notes: Cream sauces can separate if frozen; refrigerate and eat by day 3.

recipes.name: Phaphatha Flatbreads
steps: Combine flour, baking powder, salt and sugar; knead in milk to a dough.
Oil the bowl, cover and rest the dough 15-30 mins.
Divide into 12 portions and flatten into thick 10cm rounds.
Cook in a little oil 3-4 mins per side until browned in spots.

recipes.name: Pierogi (Polish Dumplings)
steps: Cook onion in butter with sauerkraut for one filling; make a mashed potato filling too.
Beat eggs and sour cream, mix with flour, salt and baking powder into a dough.
Knead, roll to 1/8 inch and cut into 3-inch rounds.
Fill rounds, fold and seal into dumplings.
Boil until they float, then serve.

recipes.name: Pilchard puttanesca
steps: Cook pasta per pack instructions.
Soften onion, garlic and chilli in oil 3-4 mins.
Stir in tomato puree, then pilchards, breaking up the fish; add olives.
Toss drained pasta with the sauce and a little cooking water.
Serve scattered with Parmesan.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Piri-piri chicken and slaw
steps: Blitz the marinade and rub onto the chicken; leave 1 hour.
Heat oven to 190C and roast the chicken 1 hr 20 mins.
Rest under foil 20 mins.
Mix and season the slaw, then serve with chicken and fries.

batch.notes: Keep cold; mayonnaise dressings separate if frozen.

recipes.name: Pisto con huevos
steps: Cook onions in oil, covered, 15 mins; add garlic 2 mins.
Add peppers and cook covered 5 mins until tender.
Stir in herbs, courgettes and aubergine; cook 10 mins, then add tomatoes and cook 20 mins.
Crack eggs over the pisto and cook 5-6 mins until just set.
Scatter with parsley and serve.

recipes.name: Pizza Express Margherita
steps: Preheat oven to 230C; dissolve sugar and yeast in warm water and rest 10-15 mins.
Mix flour and salt, add the yeast mixture and oil, and bind.
Knead 10 mins until smooth, then place on an oiled tray.
Spread passata to the edges, add mozzarella, oregano, pepper and oil.
Bake about 10 mins until crisp.

recipes.name: Polish patties (kotlety)
steps: Soak bread roll in milk; fry onion 8 mins until golden.
Mix mince with onion, egg, garlic, marjoram, seasoning and squeezed bread.
Shape into 8 patties and coat in breadcrumbs.
Fry in oil 6-7 mins per side until browned and cooked through.

recipes.name: Pollo en pepitoria
steps: Steep saffron in just-boiled water.
Fry garlic, almonds and bread until golden, then blitz with parsley and seasoning.
Brown the seasoned chicken in oil and set aside.
Cook onion, carrot and celery, add sherry, stock and saffron; return chicken and simmer.
Stir in the almond paste to thicken and serve.

recipes.name: Pomegranate salad
steps: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, honey and thyme; season.
Toss in lettuce, tomatoes, spring onions and chilli.
Scoop out pomegranate seeds and remove white membrane.
Arrange the salad and scatter with pomegranate seeds and feta.

batch.notes: Keep greens and dressing apart; assemble the day you eat it.

recipes.name: Pork & sauerkraut goulash
steps: Fry onion in lard until golden, add cumin and pork; brown 10 mins.
Add garlic, flour and paprika, cooking briefly.
Pour in half the stock with bay leaves; simmer covered 30 mins.
Add sauerkraut, remaining stock and juices; simmer 30 mins until tender.
Stir in cream, simmer 5 mins and serve with soured cream.

batch.notes: Cream sauces can separate if frozen; refrigerate and eat by day 3.

recipes.name: Pork Cassoulet
steps: Heat oven to 140C; seal diced meat in fat in an ovenproof pan.
Soften onion, garlic, carrot and fennel seeds, then deglaze with vinegar.
Add stock, tomato puree and herbs; simmer 10 mins.
Cover and cook in oven 2 hrs, adding beans for the last 30 mins.
Top with herbs and breadcrumbs, drizzle oil and grill 5-10 mins.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Pork rib bortsch
steps: Simmer meat in 5 litres water with bay leaves 1 hr until falling off the bone.
Add carrots, onions, garlic, pepper and chillies; cook 15 mins.
Stir in beetroot, then potatoes, then tomato puree and beans.
Add cabbage and cook 5 mins more; season.
Garnish with parsley and dill and serve.

recipes.name: Porotos Granados (Chilean Bean Stew)
steps: Cook onion in olive oil, covered, about 5 mins until soft.
Add squash, Northern beans and lima beans; pour in chicken stock.
Cover and cook 30-45 mins until squash breaks apart.
Stir in corn and basil; cook 10 mins until thickened.
Sprinkle chopped banana pepper over each portion to serve.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Portuguese barbecued pork (Febras assadas)
steps: Cut tenderloins into pieces and bash into thin escalopes.
Marinate pork in wine, paprika, seasoning and lemon 20-30 mins.
Cut and soak potatoes, then blanch chips in 130C oil 8-10 mins.
Fry the chips again until crisp.
Barbecue the pork over glowing coals, then serve with chips.

batch.notes: Keep cold; mayonnaise dressings separate if frozen.

recipes.name: Portuguese fish stew (Caldeirada de peixe)
steps: Fry onion and pepper, add coriander stalks, chilli and garlic.
Add wine, saffron and bay; simmer until reduced by half.
Add potatoes, tomatoes and water; simmer 20-25 mins until potatoes tender.
Season, add fish and shellfish, cover and cook 6-8 mins until shells open.
Serve with toasted garlic-rubbed bread.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Portuguese prego with green piri-piri
steps: Marinate garlic-rubbed steaks in oil, sherry vinegar and parsley 1-2 hrs.
Blend all the sauce ingredients with water until smooth.
Sear seasoned steaks 2 mins per side, then rest.
Toast ciabatta on the plate to soak up the juices.
Slice steaks and stuff into rolls with green sauce and rocket.

recipes.name: Potato Gratin with Chicken
steps: Finely slice 800g potatoes and boil 5-8 mins until firm.
Cook 3 sliced onions in an oven dish with oil and chicken stock until soft.
Drain the potatoes over the onions and season.
Spoon over cream or creme fraiche to cover and top with grated Parmesan.
Grill until golden and serve with chicken, bacon and greens.

recipes.name: Potato Moussaka Recipe
steps: Preheat oven to 350F; brown ground meat 6-7 mins.
Add onion, garlic, spices, tomato sauce and paste; cook 2-3 mins.
Layer drained potatoes and meat in a greased dish and add water to cover.
Bake 40-50 mins until the water is absorbed and potatoes cooked.
Make a bechamel with butter, flour, milk and yolks; top and bake.

recipes.name: Potato Salad (Olivier Salad)
steps: Cube potatoes and carrots, boil with salt and vinegar about 15 mins; drain and cool.
Cube sausage, pickles and hard-boiled eggs; chop green onions and dill.
Combine potatoes, carrots, sausage, pickles, peas and onions.
Mix in mayo and dill, season, and refrigerate at least 1 hr.

batch.notes: Keep cold; mayonnaise dressings separate if frozen.

recipes.name: Poulet Roti a l'Algerienne (Algerian Roast Chicken)
steps: Preheat oven to 350F.
Mix water, onion, oil, vinegar, mustard, garlic and spices in a roasting dish.
Add chicken and turn to coat well.
Bake about 1 hr 30 mins until the thigh reaches 165F.

recipes.name: Poutine
steps: Heat oil to 365F and warm the gravy.
Fry the fries about 5 mins until light brown; drain.
Pile fries on a platter and sprinkle with cheese curds.
Ladle hot gravy over the top and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Prahok Ktis – Pork and Coconut Dip
steps: Heat oil and fry garlic and shallots 2-3 mins until fragrant and golden.
Add ground pork and cook 5-7 mins until no pink remains.
Stir in prahok 1 min, then coconut milk; simmer 10 mins until thickened.
Add fish sauce, palm sugar and Thai chilies, stirring until sugar dissolves.
Serve as a dip with vegetables.

recipes.name: Prawn & Fennel Bisque
steps: Shell prawns and fry the shells in oil about 5 mins.
Add onion, fennel and carrots; cook 10 mins until softening.
Add wine and brandy, bubble 1 min, then tomatoes, stock and paprika; simmer 30 mins.
Blitz and sieve for a velvety soup, add chopped prawns and cook 10 mins; blitz again.
Reheat with cream and serve.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; it does not freeze well.

recipes.name: Prawn & noodle salad with crispy shallots
steps: Toss shallot slices in flour and fry in hot oil until golden; drain and salt.
Mix lime juice, sugar, fish sauce and garlic for the dressing.
Soak noodles in boiling water 2 mins, then rinse under cold water and drain.
Add prawns, onion, chilli, cucumber and herbs to the noodles.
Pour over dressing and top with shallots and peanuts.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; it does not freeze well.

recipes.name: Prawn stir-fry
steps: Blitz chilli, garlic, coriander and sugar, mix with lime juice and fish sauce over prawns.
Fry ginger and spring onions 1 min, add red pepper 1 min.
Add water chestnuts and bean sprouts, toss until wilting, then season and tip out.
Stir-fry prawns 1-2 mins until pink, add marinade and swirl.
Tip over the veg, add coriander and lime, and serve.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Prawns with Romesco sauce
steps: Grill pepper, garlic, chilli and tomato until blackened; peel and chop.
Toast the nuts under the grill.
Blitz nuts, parsley, pepper, chilli, garlic and tomato into a sauce.
Cook the prawns until pink.
Serve the prawns with the romesco sauce.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Presh me Oriz Leek and Rice Bake
steps: Fry leeks in olive oil a few minutes until browning.
Add onions and mince and fry until browned, stirring often.
Stir in rice to coat, then add lamb stock, salt and pepper; boil 2 mins.
Pour into a baking tray and bake at 180C up to 1 hour until liquid absorbed.
Rest 10 mins before serving.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Provençal Omelette Cake
steps: Whisk eggs in two bowls and season.
Fry courgettes and spring onions 10 mins; stir into one bowl of eggs.
Add roasted peppers, garlic and chilli to the other bowl.
Cook thin omelettes in a 20cm pan, flipping each, to make several.
Stack the omelettes into a cake and serve.

batch.notes: Reheat to 165 °F; eggs turn rubbery if frozen.

recipes.name: Purple sprouting broccoli tempura with nuoc cham
steps: Whisk the nuoc cham ingredients with 5 tbsp hot water; set aside.
Whisk cornflour, plain flour, sesame seeds and salt.
Heat oil to 180C in a deep pan.
Whisk in soda water, dunk broccoli and fry 2-3 mins until crisp.
Drain and serve with the nuoc cham for dipping.

batch.notes: The coating softens in storage; re-crisp in the oven or an air fryer.

recipes.name: Quick gazpacho
steps: Blend passata, red pepper, chilli, garlic, sherry vinegar and lime juice until smooth.
Season to taste.
Serve with ice cubes.

recipes.name: Quick salt & pepper squid
steps: Clean squid, open out the body, wash and pat dry; cut large ones into portions.
Score the top in a criss-cross, brush with oil and set aside.
Mix sea salt, Chinese five-spice and black pepper; sprinkle on both sides of the squid.
Griddle on high about 1 min per side until curling.
Drizzle with sesame oil; serve with coriander and sweet chilli sauce.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Ramen Noodles with Boiled Egg
steps: Bring water to a boil, gently add eggs and cook 6½–7 minutes.
Transfer eggs to ice water for 3–5 minutes to stop cooking.
Peel and marinate eggs in soy sauce, mirin, sugar and water 4+ hours (optional).
Slice eggs in half and serve over the hot noodle broth.

recipes.name: Rappie Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and grease a 10x14-inch baking pan.
Cook onion in butter over medium heat until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Simmer chicken in stock until cooked, then shred; reserve the broth.
Grate and wring out the potatoes, then mix with hot broth to a paste.
Layer potato and chicken in the pan and bake until golden and crisp.

recipes.name: Raspeballer (Norwegian Potato Dumplings)
steps: Simmer pork knuckle in water about 3 hours until tender; reserve the broth.
Boil and peel cooked potatoes; peel and grate the raw potatoes.
Mix grated and mashed potato with flour and salt into a dumpling dough.
Shape dumplings and simmer in the reserved broth until they float and cook through.
Serve with sausage, swede, carrots and melted butter.

batch.notes: Cream sauces can separate if frozen; refrigerate and eat by day 3.

recipes.name: Ratatouille
steps: Cut aubergine, courgette, peppers and tomato into 1.5cm chunks.
Fry the vegetables separately in olive oil until golden, then set aside.
Soften onion and garlic, then add tomatoes, vinegar and sugar for a sauce.
Combine all the vegetables and simmer gently until tender.
Stir through torn basil before serving.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Recheado Masala Fish
steps: Soak chillies, ginger, garlic, tamarind and spices in vinegar with sugar and salt.
Marinate the spice mix 35–40 minutes, then grind to a thick smooth paste.
Slit and coat the mackerel with the recheado masala paste.
Shallow-fry the fish in oil until crisp and cooked through.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Red curry chicken kebabs
steps: Heat a barbecue or griddle pan to high.
Toss chicken with curry paste and coconut milk until evenly coated.
Thread the chicken and vegetables onto skewers.
Grill 5–8 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Serve with rice, salad and a squeeze of lime.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Red onion pickle
steps: Finely slice the red onions into half-moons.
Toss with salt in a colander and brine about 1 hour.
Warm the cider vinegar with sugar, pepper and bay leaves.
Pack the drained onions into jars and cover with the pickling liquid.

recipes.name: Red Peas Soup
steps: Soak the kidney beans overnight, then drain.
Simmer beans and beef in water until both are tender.
Add carrots, potatoes, onion, garlic and spices and cook until soft.
Mix flour and water into small spinners and drop into the soup.
Stir in coconut milk and simmer until thickened.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Ribollita
steps: Cook onion, carrot, celery and garlic in olive oil until soft, 5–10 minutes.
Heat oven to 500°F, then add beans, tomatoes, water and herbs to the pot.
Stir in the kale and simmer until wilted and tender.
Layer the soup with torn bread and top with parmesan.
Bake until bubbling and crisp on top.

recipes.name: Rice paper dumplings
steps: Finely chop cabbage, salt it, rest 15 minutes and squeeze out water.
Mix cabbage with carrot, mushrooms, pork, garlic, ginger, soy and sesame oil.
Soften rice paper sheets, add filling and fold into parcels.
Pan-fry the dumplings in oil until golden and crisp.
Serve with a soy and rice vinegar dipping sauce.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Rigatoni with fennel sausage sauce
steps: Fry the sliced sausages in oil over medium-high heat 10 minutes until golden.
Add onion and fennel and cook 15 minutes until soft.
Stir in paprika, garlic and fennel seeds, then add wine, tomatoes, sugar and olives.
Simmer the sauce while you boil the rigatoni until al dente.
Toss pasta with the sauce and a pecorino-anchovy pesto, then finish with basil.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Roast aubergine with goat's cheese & toasted flatbread
steps: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6.
Brush aubergine slices with oil, season and roast 20 minutes until browned.
Add the tomatoes to the tray for the final 5 minutes.
Tear and toast the flatbread until crisp.
Top with goat's cheese, mint, shallots, chilli and rocket; drizzle with balsamic.

recipes.name: Roast fennel and aubergine paella
steps: Toss fennel, aubergine, pepper and courgette with oil and season in a roasting tray.
Roast 20 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through.
Fry the onion, then add paella rice, paprika and saffron to toast.
Pour in the white wine and stock and simmer until the rice is tender.
Stir through peas and roasted vegetables; finish with lemon and parsley.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Roasted chicken with creamy walnut sauce
steps: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6.
Toss chicken thighs with cumin, paprika, oil and seasoning.
Roast 40 minutes until crisp and cooked through.
Blend soaked pitta, walnuts, onion, garlic, stock and cream into a sauce.
Serve the chicken with the walnut sauce, lemon and coriander.

batch.notes: Cream sauces can separate if frozen; refrigerate and eat by day 3.

recipes.name: Roasted Eggplant With Tahini, Pine Nuts, and Lentils
steps: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Cook carrots, celery and onion in olive oil until softened.
Add lentils, garlic, bay and water; simmer until tender, then season with vinegar.
Roast the eggplant until soft and browned.
Serve eggplant over the lentils with pine nuts, rosemary and parsley.

recipes.name: Rømmegrøt – Norwegian Sour Cream Porridge
steps: Simmer the sour cream, covered, over medium heat about 5 minutes.
Whisk in half the flour and cook until the butterfat separates out.
Spoon off the released fat to serve on top.
Whisk in the milk and remaining flour and cook to a smooth porridge.
Serve with sugar, cinnamon and the reserved butter.

recipes.name: Rosemary braised red cabbage with kabanos
steps: Halve, core and thinly slice the red cabbage.
Combine cabbage with onion, vinegar, sugar, chilli, rosemary and apple in a pan.
Add 300ml water, season and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook gently about 1½ hours until tender.
Stir in the kabanos sausages and heat through.

recipes.name: Rosol (Polish Chicken Soup)
steps: Cover the chicken with water in a large pot.
Bring to a boil and simmer 2 to 2½ hours, skimming for a clear broth.
Add carrots, leek, celery, cabbage and spices for the final hour.
Season with salt and pepper.
Strain and serve the broth with parsley and dill.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Roti john
steps: Mix the minced beef, onion, egg, chilli and seasoning in a bowl.
Heat a little oil in a pan or griddle.
Pour on the mixture and press an open baguette on top.
Grill about 2 minutes, then flip to crisp the bread.
Cut into portions and serve with mayonnaise or sambal.

batch.notes: Keep cold; mayonnaise dressings separate if frozen.

recipes.name: Runner Bean Mash (Snijbonen Stamppot)
steps: Wash and chop the runner beans.
Boil the beans in salted water about 10 minutes until al dente, then drain.
Boil the potatoes until tender.
Sauté onion and garlic in butter, then fry the bacon.
Mash potatoes with milk, mustard and cheese; fold in beans and bacon.

recipes.name: Rye bread
steps: Combine the rye and white flours, yeast, salt and caraway seeds.
Mix honey with 250ml warm water and stir into a soft dough.
Knead well, adding water if dry, then leave to rise until doubled.
Shape into a loaf and prove again.
Bake until risen and hollow-sounding when tapped.

recipes.name: Salmon Avocado Salad
steps: Season salmon and rub with oil; mix the dressing ingredients together.
Halve, stone, peel and slice the avocados; slice the cucumber.
Divide salad, avocado and cucumber between plates; drizzle with half the dressing.
Fry salmon in a hot non-stick pan 3-4 mins each side until crisp but moist.
Top each salad with a fillet, drizzle remaining dressing and serve warm.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; it does not freeze well.

recipes.name: Salmon Eggs Eggs Benedict
steps: Whisk lemon juice, vinegar and egg yolks over simmering water until thick; add butter, season, keep warm.
Poach eggs in simmering water with vinegar about 4 mins; lift out with a slotted spoon.
Toast and butter the muffins, then top with smoked salmon.
Add a poached egg, spoon over Hollandaise and garnish with chives.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Salmon noodle soup
steps: Boil the stock, stir in curry paste, then add noodles and cook 8 mins.
Add mushrooms and corn and cook 2 mins more.
Add salmon and cook 3 mins until cooked through.
Stir in lime juice, soy sauce and a pinch of sugar; ladle into bowls and top with coriander.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Salmon noodle wraps
steps: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan. Soak noodles in boiling water 2 mins, then drain.
Mix noodles with spring onions, petit pois, seasoning and a third of the butter.
Pile onto parchment squares, sit salmon on top and dot with remaining butter.
Wrap into sealed parcels; bake on a sheet 15-20 mins and serve at once.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Salmon Prawn Risotto
steps: Melt butter and gently cook onion until soft; stir in rice to coat.
Add the wine and stir until absorbed.
Add hot stock gradually, stirring until absorbed and the rice is tender.
Season with lemon juice, zest and pepper; stir to heat through.
Grill salmon; serve risotto topped with salmon, prawns, asparagus and Parmesan.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Salt & pepper squid
steps: Mix the dipping sauce ingredients until the sugar dissolves; set aside.
Combine cornflour, plain flour, both peppers and 2 tsp sea salt.
Heat 7cm of oil to 180C and coat the squid in the flour mix.
Fry in batches about 2 mins each until crisp; drain and sprinkle with salt.
Serve scattered with spring onion and chilli, dipping sauce alongside.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; it does not freeze well.

recipes.name: Salt cod tortilla
steps: Saute onion in half the oil about 8 mins until soft; set aside, then cook potatoes until tender.
Return onions with garlic, cook 4 mins; mix with eggs, parsley and seasoning and rest 30 mins.
Simmer cod off the heat 10 mins; drain, skin, flake and add to the egg mix.
Cook the tortilla in remaining oil over medium-low heat until just set.
Flip onto a plate and back into the pan; cook until golden, then cool before serving.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Saltfish and Ackee
steps: Soak salt cod overnight; boil in fresh water, changing it, then simmer 5 mins and flake.
Mix flour and suet with salt and 250ml water into a dough; rest in the fridge.
Drain and rinse the ackee and set aside.
Fry onion, then spices, seasoning, pepper sauce and peppers; add tomatoes and cod, fold in ackee and simmer.
Shallow-fry plum-size dumpling balls in 1cm oil until golden; drain and serve with the saltfish.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Satee
steps: Blend onion, garlic, lemon juice, sugar, soy sauce, salt, spice and 1 cup oil into a marinade.
Pour over 5 lbs cubed beef or pork; marinate only a few hours, not overnight.
Thread the meat onto skewers.
Blend 1 cup oil with 2 tbsp soy sauce; roll each skewer in it before cooking.
Fry or barbecue the skewers until cooked.

recipes.name: Sauerkraut pierogi
steps: Fry flour-tossed shallots in 180C oil until golden and crispy; drain for topping.
Fry shallots 10 mins, add sauerkraut and cabbage and cook 5-10 mins; season and cool.
Make dough from eggs, oil, 125ml water and flour; knead, then rest 30 mins in the fridge.
Roll out thin and cut 9cm discs; fill each with 1 tsp filling and seal into half-moons.
Boil 2 mins until they float; serve with butter, soured cream and crispy shallots.

recipes.name: Sauerkraut pierogii
steps: Fry flour-tossed shallots in 180C oil until golden and crispy; drain for topping.
Fry shallots 10 mins, add sauerkraut and cabbage and cook 5-10 mins; season and cool.
Make dough from eggs, oil, 125ml water and flour; knead, then rest 30 mins in the fridge.
Roll out thin and cut 9cm discs; fill each with 1 tsp filling and seal into half-moons.
Boil 2 mins until they float; serve with butter, soured cream and crispy shallots.

recipes.name: Sea bass with sizzled ginger, chilli & spring onions
steps: Season 6 sea bass fillets, then slash the skin 3 times.
Fry skin-side down in 1 tbsp oil about 5 mins until the skin is crisp and golden.
Turn and cook 30 secs-1 min; keep warm, frying in 2 batches.
Fry ginger matchsticks, sliced garlic and shredded chillies in 2 tbsp oil about 2 mins until golden.
Toss in shredded spring onions; splash fish with 1 tbsp soy sauce and spoon over.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Seafood fideuà
steps: Clean the mussels, discarding any that stay open; peel the prawn bodies and devein.
Soak saffron in 50ml hot water 10 mins; crush the vermicelli into short pieces.
Fry onion 5 mins, add garlic, then toast the vermicelli 5 mins and stir in paprika.
Add monkfish, squid, saffron water and stock; scatter tomatoes, cover and cook 6 mins.
Push in mussels and prawns; cook 6 mins more until open and pink, finish with lemon and parsley.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Seafood rice
steps: Soften leek in oil 5 mins; add chorizo and fry until it releases its oils.
Stir in turmeric and rice to coat, then pour in the stock.
Bring to the boil, then simmer 15 mins, stirring occasionally.
Add peas and cook 5 mins, then stir in the seafood 1-2 mins until hot.
Season and serve with lemon wedges.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Shakshouka
steps: Dry-fry the black pepper and garlic until fragrant.
Add extra virgin olive oil and infuse 1 min.
Add tomatoes and salt, cover and simmer 5 mins; mash and reduce to desired consistency.
Make craters, crack in the eggs, cover and cook over low heat 5 mins.
Off the heat, let residual heat steam the eggs 1-2 mins; serve with flatbread.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
steps: Soften onions, chilli, garlic and coriander stalks in oil 5 mins.
Stir in tomatoes and sugar; bubble 8-10 mins until thick.
Make 4 dips in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook over low heat 6-8 mins until the eggs are set to your liking.
Scatter with coriander and serve with crusty bread.

batch.notes: Reheat to 165 °F; eggs turn rubbery if frozen.

recipes.name: Shakshuka Feta Cheese
steps: Heat oil over medium-high heat with a tablespoon of olive oil.
Add onions, garlic, celery and red pepper and stir 5 mins.
Add cumin, seasoning and tomato sauce and cook 7 mins.
Add the eggs, cover and cook 8 mins.
Stir in fresh spinach and feta at the end; serve with bread.

batch.notes: Reheat to 165 °F; eggs turn rubbery if frozen.

recipes.name: Shawarma
steps: Coat the chicken in the marinade and refrigerate overnight or up to 24 hours.
Mix the yoghurt sauce and chill until needed.
Grill chicken over medium-high 4-5 mins, turn and cook 3-4 mins until charred and cooked.
Rest under loose foil 5 mins, then slice.
Serve in flatbreads with yoghurt sauce, lettuce and tomato.

recipes.name: Shawarma bread
steps: Sieve the flour and mix with baking powder, salt, sugar and oil.
Add water and knead the dough about 10 mins.
Cover and leave to rise.
Shape into rounds on a floured work surface.
Cook in a hot pan, turning once, until puffed with a pocket.

recipes.name: Shawarma chuck roast wrap
steps: In a dutch oven or slow cooker, combine spices, beef broth and lemon juice.
Add beef, coat and spoon sauce over; cover and cook on low 8-10 hours.
Remove the beef and shred with two forks, discarding fat.
Skim fat from the liquid and mix the shredded beef back into the sauce.
Build wraps with garlic sauce, beef and garnishes; fold and grill in a hot pan.

batch.notes: Pack the parts separately; assemble when you eat.

recipes.name: Shrimp Chow Fun
steps: Soak the rice noodles overnight until soft.
Boil the noodles 10-15 mins, then rinse with cold water.
Marinate shrimp with egg, white pepper, sesame oil, cornstarch and oil.
Stir-fry shrimp in 2 tbsp oil until golden; set aside.
Fry garlic, ginger and vegetables, add noodles, sauces and shrimp; thicken with cornstarch slurry.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Shrimp With Snow Peas
steps: Mix the marinade, add the shrimp and let sit 15-20 mins.
Heat wok 1 min, add peanut oil, then stir-fry ginger and garlic about 30 secs.
Add shrimp with marinade, snow peas, soy sauce and stock; stir-fry ~2 mins until shrimp turn pink.
Add scallions and stir-fry 1 min more.
Off the heat, add sesame oil, toss and serve with steamed rice.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Sichuan Eggplant
steps: Quarter and cut the eggplant into large batons.
Mix stock, sugar and soy sauce; separately mix chilli bean paste, garlic, ginger and Sichuan peppercorns.
Also make a cornstarch slurry and mix the scallions with vinegar.
Saute eggplant in near-smoking oil until browned and blistered.
Add paste mix 30 secs, add stock mix and simmer 90 secs, thicken with slurry, add scallions, garnish cilantro.

recipes.name: Sichuan Style Stir-Fried Chinese Long Beans
steps: Choose green or purple Chinese long beans; both have similar flavour and texture.
Use a wok, or a sturdy large saute pan with at least a two-inch lip.
Stir-fry the long beans Sichuan-style until blistered and tender.

batch.notes: The coating softens in storage; re-crisp in the oven or an air fryer.

recipes.name: Silken Tofu with Sesame Soy Sauce
steps: Drain the silken tofu and turn out onto a large plate.
Slice into 1/2-inch slabs widthwise.
Gently push the slices sideways so they fan out over the plate.
Drizzle with soy sauce and sesame sauce.
Garnish with scallions and sesame seeds and serve.

recipes.name: Singapore Noodles with Shrimp
steps: Combine sesame oil, soy sauce and rice vinegar for the sauce.
Boil rice noodles 2 mins, drain, rinse cold and snip into shorter lengths.
Scramble the eggs in 1 tbsp oil about 2 mins; set aside.
Fry ginger, garlic, carrots, jalapeno and onion 2 mins.
Add ham, cabbage, pepper and curry 1 min, shrimp 3 mins, then toss in eggs, sauce and noodles until hot.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Skillet Apple Pork Chops with Roasted Sweet Potatoes & Zucchini
steps: Preheat oven to 450F; roast diced sweet potatoes on the top rack 12 mins.
Prep apple, garlic, lemon and zucchini; toss zucchini with oil and seasoning.
Season pork and sear in oil 4-5 mins per side until cooked; set aside.
Add zucchini to the oven and roast 12-15 mins more until browned.
Make apple glaze in butter with garlic, water, stock concentrate and sugar; serve pork topped with it.

recipes.name: Sledz w Oleju (Polish Herrings)
steps: Soak the herring in cold water at least 1 hour, changing water if very salty.
Drain well and slice into bite-size pieces.
Pack into a jar with oil, allspice, peppercorns and bay leaf and close.
Refrigerate 2-3 days before eating (keeps up to 2 weeks).
Serve with chopped onion, lemon and parsley or dill.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Slow-cooked, Wadadli-spiced Cubano pork belly
steps: Blitz the marinade, rub all over the pork belly and marinate overnight in the fridge.
Next day, heat oven to 140C/275F; roast covered with foil 4.5 hours, basting a few times.
Remove the foil, raise to 180C/350F and roast 15-20 mins until coloured and tender.
For crackling, score skin, salt it, cut into strips and roast at 200C/390F between trays 45-60 mins.
Pull the pork, top with coriander, parsley and crackling shards and serve.

recipes.name: Tafelspitz
steps: Halve the unpeeled onion and fry the cut sides without fat until well browned.
Boil about 3L water with root veg, leek, onion, bay leaves and peppercorns; add beef and bones.
Simmer gently 2.5-3 hours, skimming off foam and topping up water as needed.
Season with salt only after 2 hours, then remove the meat and keep warm in some broth.
Strain the soup, slice the beef on the bias and serve with potatoes and horseradish.

recipes.name: Tahini Lentils
steps: Mix tahini with lemon zest, juice and 50ml water into a runny dressing; season.
Heat oil in a wok and fry the red onion with a pinch of salt for 2 mins until softening.
Add garlic, pepper, green beans and courgette; fry 5 mins, stirring frequently.
Stir in kale, lentils and the dressing; cook a couple mins until the kale wilts.

recipes.name: Tajine de Poulet aux Carottes et Patates Douces (Chicken and Sweet Potato Tagine)
steps: Combine onions, celery, cilantro, parsley and spices in a pot; top with chicken and oil.
Cover and simmer over low heat until the chicken is tender, about 40 mins.
Soak raisins in hot water 10 mins then drain; heat oven to 400F (200C).
Transfer to a tagine with sweet potato and carrots; cover and bake 40 mins until soft.
Add drained raisins and prunes; bake covered 10 mins more until heated through.

recipes.name: Tamiya
steps: Soak the beans overnight, drain, remove skins if needed and pat dry.
Grind beans to a paste, then mix in scallions, garlic, herbs and spices; chill 30 mins.
Shape into 1-inch balls, flatten slightly and coat with flour.
Heat at least 1.5 inches of oil to 365F.
Fry patties in batches, turning once, until golden, about 5 mins; drain and serve.

recipes.name: Tandoori chicken
steps: Mix lemon juice, paprika and red onions in a dish; slash and add chicken, rest 10 mins.
Combine all marinade ingredients, pour over the chicken, cover and chill at least 1 hour.
Heat the grill, set chicken on a rack over a tray and brush with a little oil.
Grill 8 mins each side until lightly charred and cooked through.

recipes.name: Tangy cabbage slaw
steps: Whisk mayonnaise, lemon zest and juice, vinegar, mustard and celery salt; season well.
Add the cabbage, carrots, onion and celery and mix well.
Refrigerate until serving; can be made up to a day ahead.

batch.notes: Keep cold; mayonnaise dressings separate if frozen.

recipes.name: Tangy carrot, cabbage & onion salad
steps: Tip the carrots, cabbage and onions into a bowl.
Stir the dressing ingredients until the sugar dissolves, then pour over and toss.
Add the herbs, toss again, then scatter over the peanuts.

recipes.name: Tavë Kosi Baked Lamb and Yogurt
steps: Melt butter and oil, then brown the diced lamb over medium heat, about 5 mins.
Add garlic, oregano, 300ml water and seasoning; cover and simmer 50 mins.
Add 150ml water and the rice; cover 10 mins, then spread in a casserole dish.
Make a roux with butter and flour, then whisk into yogurt beaten with eggs and seasoning.
Pour over the lamb and bake at 180C for 35 mins, then 10 mins higher until golden; rest.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Tavë me Presh ska Mish Meatless Leek Bake
steps: Fry the leeks in a little olive oil for a few mins until they start to brown.
Add peppers, garlic, stock, herbs and spices, then stir in the rice.
Bring to the boil and simmer 2 mins.
Pour into a baking tray at least 2 inches deep and level it out.
Bake at 180C for 1 hour, then rest 10 mins with the oven off and door open.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Tendir Choreyi (Tandoori Bread)
steps: Mix the yeast with the water and let stand a few minutes.
Sift flour with salt, gradually add the yeast water and mix to a dough ball.
Knead 8-10 mins until smooth, then cover and rise until doubled, 1-1.5 hours.
Punch down, roll to about 1/2 inch thick, transfer to a baking sheet and rest 15 mins.
Crosshatch the top, brush with egg yolk, add poppy seeds and bake at 400F 20-25 mins.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Chicken Casserole
steps: Heat oven to 350F and spray a 9x13-inch baking pan with non-stick spray.
Boil soy sauce, 1/2 cup water, brown sugar, ginger and garlic, then simmer 1 min.
Stir cornstarch with 2 tbsp water, add to the sauce and cook until thickened.
Place chicken in the pan, pour over 1 cup sauce, bake 35 mins, then shred.
Add cooked veg, rice and most remaining sauce; toss and bake 15 mins, rest 5 mins.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Thai beef stir-fry
steps: Heat a wok until smoking hot, then swirl in the oil.
Add the beef strips and chilli and stir-fry until lightly browned, about 3 mins.
Pour over the oyster sauce and cook until it coats the meat.
Stir in the basil leaves and serve with plain rice.

recipes.name: Thai chicken cakes with sweet chilli sauce
steps: Blitz chicken, garlic, ginger, onion, coriander and chilli in a processor; season.
Shape the mixture into six small cakes with your hands.
Fry the cakes in oil over medium heat 6-8 mins, turning once.
Serve hot with sweet chilli sauce, lime, coriander, spring onion and red chilli.

recipes.name: Thai coconut & veg broth
steps: Fry the curry paste in the oil for 1 min until fragrant.
Add stock, coconut milk and brown sugar, then simmer 3 mins.
Add noodles, carrots and Chinese leaf and simmer 4-6 mins until tender.
Mix in beansprouts and tomatoes, add lime juice, then top with spring onions and coriander.

batch.notes: Cook the pasta 1–2 min short; it softens on reheating.

recipes.name: Thai curry noodle soup
steps: Heat the oil and cook the curry paste 1 min, then add stir-fry veg and prawns.
Cook 3 mins until prawns are mostly pink, then add coconut milk, stock and noodles.
Bring to the boil, then simmer 5 mins until noodles are cooked and veg is tender.
Divide between bowls and top with herbs, chilli and spring onion.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Thai drumsticks
steps: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan and line a baking tray with foil.
Mix chilli sauce, orange zest and juice, garlic, curry paste and salt; coat the chicken.
Arrange the drumsticks spaced apart, coating with any leftover marinade.
Roast 35-40 mins until tender.

recipes.name: Thai fried rice with prawns & peas
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok and cook onion, garlic and chilli 2-3 mins until golden.
Add the prawns for 1 min, then the rice and peas, tossing until very hot.
Add soy and fish sauce, stir through the coriander and keep warm.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil, then top each bowl of rice with an egg.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Thai green chicken soup
steps: Heat oil and fry the onion 3 mins, then add chicken and garlic until colour changes.
Add curry paste, coconut milk, stock, lime leaves and fish sauce; simmer 12 mins.
Add onion tops, green beans and bamboo shoots; cook 4-6 mins until beans are tender.
Blitz lime juice and basil to a paste, then stir in with spring onion and heat through.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Thai Green Curry
steps: Boil potatoes 5 mins, add beans for 3 mins more until just tender, then drain.
Heat oil and fry garlic until golden, then stir the curry paste for a few seconds.
Add coconut milk to a bubble, then fish sauce, sugar and chicken; simmer covered 8 mins.
Tip in potatoes and beans to warm through, then stir in lime leaves and basil.
Scatter with lime and serve immediately with boiled rice.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Thai pork & peanut curry
steps: Heat oil, cook spring onions and coriander stalks 1 min, then brown the pork 5 mins.
Stir in curry paste and peanut butter, then sugar, soy, coconut milk and 1/2 can water.
Cover and simmer 15 mins, stirring occasionally.
Add baby corn and bubble 3 mins uncovered until the sauce thickens.
Stir in lime juice, then serve scattered with coriander and rice.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Thai prawn curry
steps: Heat oil and cook the onion and ginger a few mins until softened.
Stir in the curry paste 1 min, then add the tomatoes and coconut cream.
Bring to the boil, then simmer 5 mins, loosening with boiling water if too thick.
Add the prawns and cook 5-10 mins; serve with rice and chopped coriander.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Thai pumpkin soup
steps: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan; toss pumpkin in half the oil and roast 30 mins until tender.
Cook onion, ginger and lemongrass in the remaining oil 8-10 mins until softened.
Stir in curry paste 1 min, then add pumpkin, most of the coconut milk and stock; simmer 5 mins.
Remove the lemongrass and blend smooth, then reheat and season with lime, salt and sugar.
Serve drizzled with the remaining coconut milk and scattered with chilli.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Thai rice noodle salad
steps: Cover noodles and beansprouts with boiling water 4 mins, then drain, cool and drain again.
Stir lime zest and juice, fish or soy sauce and sugar, then toss through the noodles.
Mix in the red onion and lettuce.
For mince: stir-fry pork with ginger and cayenne 10 mins, then toss through and serve warm.
For steak: press sirloin in sesame, fry 5 mins, rest, slice and top the salad.

batch.notes: Keep greens and dressing apart; assemble the day you eat it.

recipes.name: Thai-style fish broth with greens
steps: Cook the noodles per pack, refresh in cold water and drain well.
Simmer stock with curry paste, lime leaves, fish sauce and 250ml water for 5 mins.
Cut the fish into 3cm cubes, add and simmer 2 mins uncovered.
Stir in noodles, prawns and pak choi; simmer 2-3 mins until just cooked.
Serve in bowls scattered with coriander.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Thai-style steamed fish
steps: Set the fish on a large square of foil and scatter with ginger, garlic, chilli and lime zest.
Drizzle over the lime juice, add the pak choi and soy sauce, then loosely seal the parcel.
Steam for 15 minutes until the fish is just cooked.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Three Fish Pie
steps: Heat oven to 200C/400F; boil potatoes until tender, then mash with butter and milk.
Simmer leeks in butter, covered, 10 mins; whisk flour with the wine until smooth.
Add milk to leeks, boil, then stir in wine mix until thickened; add parsley and fish.
Spoon into a dish, scatter over the eggs and cool until firm.
Top with mash, mark with a fork, sprinkle cheese and bake 30-40 mins until golden.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Three-cheese souffles
steps: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan; butter ramekins and coat inside with Parmesan.
Boil milk with bay leaves and infuse 15 mins; discard bay, add butter and flour.
Simmer gently 6 mins to a thick sauce, then stir in mustard, cayenne, Gruyere and yolks.
Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks and fold into the sauce in three stages.
Fill ramekins, top with goat's cheese and bake 20-25 mins until risen.

batch.notes: Cream sauces can separate if frozen; refrigerate and eat by day 3.

recipes.name: Tirolean Dumplings
steps: Chop shallots and dice ham; sweat shallots in butter, then add ham and parsley briefly.
Beat the milk with the eggs, season well, then pour over the bread in a bowl.
Stir in the ham mixture and flour to a firm paste, then rest 30 mins.
Wet your hands and shape into dumplings, then drop into salted boiling water.
Simmer gently 8-20 mins, drain and serve with parsley and browned butter.

recipes.name: Toad In The Hole
steps: Heat oven to 200C/fan180C and fry the sausages until browned.
Drizzle oil in a roasting tray and heat in the oven for 5 mins.
Whisk flour, eggs, horseradish and milk into a batter and season.
Add sausages to the hot tray, pour over batter, top with tomatoes and bake 30 mins.

recipes.name: Tofu, greens & cashew stir-fry
steps: Heat oil in a wok and fry broccoli on high 5 mins until just tender, adding water if needed.
Add garlic and chilli 1 min, then toss in spring onions, soya beans, pak choi and tofu.
Stir-fry for 2-3 mins.
Add the hoisin, soy and cashews to warm through.

recipes.name: Tom kha gai
steps: Simmer chicken stock and coconut milk with galangal, lemongrass and lime leaves 6-8 mins.
Add the chicken and cook 8-10 mins until tender.
Add mushrooms and chillies, simmer 3-5 mins, then season with sugar, fish sauce and lime.
Remove galangal, lemongrass and lime leaves; serve with coriander and steamed rice.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Tom yum (hot & sour) soup with prawns
steps: Boil the stock, then add lemongrass, galangal, coriander roots and lime leaves; simmer 2 mins.
Add prawns, fish sauce, chillies and lime juice, then return to the boil.
Taste and adjust with more lime juice or fish sauce.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Tom yum soup with prawns
steps: Boil 1.3L water with onion, tomato, chilli, galangal, lemongrass, prawn heads and stock cube.
Simmer 20 mins, then strain, discard prawn heads and return veg and broth to the pan.
Add mushrooms and lime leaves and cook 3 mins until the mushrooms are tender.
Add sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, coconut milk and prawns; boil 1-2 mins until cooked.
Remove lemongrass, stir in chilli jam and coriander, then serve.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Tonkatsu pork
steps: Trim the fat and bash the pork loins to about 1cm thick, then reshape by hand.
Dip the seasoned pork in flour, then beaten egg, then panko breadcrumbs.
Heat 2cm oil to 180C; fry chops 1 min 30 secs each side, then rest on a rack 5 mins.
Whisk the sauce ingredients, then slice the pork and serve drizzled with sauce.

recipes.name: Torrijas
steps: Grate orange and lemon zest into a saucepan with milk, sugar and cinnamon stick.
Boil, then off the heat stir in the sherry; slice the baguette into 1-inch slices.
Pour the milk over the bread and soak 5 mins, flip, then soak 5 mins more.
Heat 1 cup olive oil until shimmering and whisk 4 eggs in a bowl.
Dip bread in egg, fry about 4 mins per side until golden, drain, then drizzle with honey.

recipes.name: Ugali – Kenyan cornmeal
steps: Bring the water to a boil in a medium saucepan.
Reduce heat to low and whisk in the cornmeal slowly; it thickens quickly.
Stir constantly on low with a wooden spoon until it pulls from the sides and smells of roasted corn.
Turn out onto a plate and shape into a thick disk; it firms as it cools.

recipes.name: Vegan banh mi
steps: Toss shredded veg with vinegar, sugar and 1 tsp salt; set aside to pickle.
Heat oven to 180C; halve the baguette pieces and toast 5 min until warm.
Spread with hummus, then add tempeh slices and pickled veg.
Top with coriander, mint and hot sauce, then close the sandwiches.

recipes.name: Vegan Chocolate Cake
steps: Mix all the dry ingredients with the wet ingredients and blend together.
Bake at 180C for 45 min.
Decorate with melted vegan chocolate.

recipes.name: Vegan Lasagna
steps: Preheat oven to 180C; boil vegetables 5-7 min, add lentils and simmer ~20 min until soft.
Blanch spinach briefly, then cook the lasagne sheets, drain and set aside.
Make sauce: melt butter, stir in flour, then soya milk, mustard and vinegar until smooth.
Assemble the lasagne in a baking dish and bake ~25 min.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Vegetable Shepherds Pie
steps: Bake potatoes at 450F ~45 min, then peel, rice and mix with butter and milk for the topping.
Soak dried porcini; simmer brown lentils 15-20 min until tender, then drain.
Cook mushrooms, onion and vegetables with wine, stock and seasonings for the filling.
Top the filling with the mashed potato and bake until golden.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Vegetarian Casserole
steps: Heat oil and cook the onions gently 5-10 min until softened.
Add garlic, spices, thyme, carrots, celery and peppers; cook 5 min.
Add tomatoes, stock, courgettes and thyme; cook 20-25 min.
Remove thyme, stir in lentils and simmer; serve with rice, mash or quinoa.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Vegetarian Chilli
steps: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan; cook the vegetables in a casserole dish 15 min.
Add beans and tomatoes, season, and cook 10-15 min until piping hot.
Heat the grain pouch in the microwave 1 min and serve with the chilli.

batch.notes: Freezes well: freeze the Thu–Fri portions on Sunday.

recipes.name: Vegetarian Shakshuka
steps: Fry onion and pepper over medium heat until the onion softens.
Add garlic granules for a minute, then tomatoes and remaining spices; stir well.
Simmer about 20 minutes.
Make indents, crack an egg into each, cook until whites set, then serve with toast.

batch.notes: Reheat to 165 °F; eggs turn rubbery if frozen.

recipes.name: Venetian Duck Ragu
steps: Heat oil and brown duck legs ~10 min; remove, then soften onions 5 min and add garlic 1 min.
Stir in cinnamon and flour, return duck, add wine, tomatoes, stock, herbs, sugar and seasoning.
Simmer covered 2 hrs, stirring occasionally.
Shred the duck, discard bones, stir back with milk and simmer; toss with pasta and parmesan.

batch.notes: Cook the pasta 1–2 min short; it softens on reheating.

recipes.name: Venezuelan Arepas
steps: Preheat to 410F; pour room-temperature water into a bowl and blend in the salt to dissolve.
Slowly beat in the corn meal until smooth and fully blended.
Rest the masa 5 min, then heat a griddle over medium heat.
Form patties and cook on the griddle until done.

recipes.name: Venezuelan Coconut Chicken
steps: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces; peel and chop onions and mince garlic.
Saute onion in oil until translucent, then blend with tomatoes, garlic, spices, coconut milk and water.
Brown the chicken ~3 min in the same pan.
Add the blended sauce and bay leaves; simmer 15-20 min until creamy, then serve with rice.

recipes.name: Venezuelan Sancocho
steps: Simmer hind shank with onion, pepper, garlic, leek greens and stock 45-60 min until fork-tender.
Remove and discard the large vegetables and bones.
Add onion, garlic, sweet peppers, leeks, scallions, yucca and corn; simmer 5-8 min.
Add yautia, white yam and squash; simmer 5-6 min until tender, then season to taste.

recipes.name: Venezuelan Shredded Beef
steps: Season beef with salt, pepper and garlic; add to pressure cooker with onion and stock.
Pressure cook 20 min, release, then shred the beef and save 2 cups of stock.
Saute onion, pepper and tomatoes in oil until tender.
Return beef with saved stock, Worcestershire, tomato paste, ketchup and cumin; mix and serve.

recipes.name: Venezuelan turnovers
steps: Season beef with Adobo and cook in oil until browned.
Stir in onion, pepper, garlic, capers, tomato sauce and Sazon; cook ~20 min until dry, then cool.
Roll dough into balls, flatten to 5-inch circles on parchment, fill and fold into semi-circles.
Seal the edges, then fry in 1/2 inch hot oil until lightly browned.

recipes.name: Vietnamese caramel trout
steps: Dissolve sugar with a splash of water, then boil to a dark amber caramel.
Add fish sauce, most of the chilli and ginger, then 1 tbsp water; boil until syrupy.
Add trout skin-side down and bok choi cut-side down; cover and simmer 4-5 min.
Squeeze over lemon, scatter remaining chilli, ginger and coriander; serve with rice.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Vietnamese chicken salad
steps: Whisk the dressing in a bowl; cook noodles per pack, drain and add to the dressing.
Peel the carrot and cucumber into long strips and add to the noodles.
Add shredded chicken, radishes, red onion and mint; toss well to coat.
Scatter over the peanuts and serve.

batch.notes: Add the cucumber fresh; it turns watery in storage.

recipes.name: Vietnamese Grilled Pork (bun-thit-nuong)
steps: Slice the pork thinly (~1/8 inch); slightly freezing it helps.
Mix garlic, shallots, sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, pepper and oil until the sugar dissolves.
Marinate the pork 1 hour, or overnight for better results.
Bake at 375F 10-15 min until ~80% cooked, then finish under the broiler.

batch.notes: Add the cucumber fresh; it turns watery in storage.

recipes.name: Vietnamese lamb shanks with sweet potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 160C/140C fan; brown the seasoned lamb shanks in batches, then remove.
Fry onions; add ginger, garlic and chilli, then sugar, star anise, lemongrass, stock and puree; boil.
Cover and cook in oven 1½ hrs, add sweet potatoes and cook 1 hr more until tender.
Stir in fish sauce, lime and sugar, then scatter with mint, basil and chilli to serve.

recipes.name: Vietnamese pork salad
steps: A day ahead, boil sugar and lime juice, add chilli and coriander, blend, then mix in oils and sauces.
Heat a griddle and the oven to 200C; brush pork with oil and sear on all sides.
Roast the pork 10-12 min until cooked, cool, thinly slice and coat with half the dressing.
Toss remaining salad with the rest of the dressing, plate and top with the pork.

batch.notes: Add the cucumber fresh; it turns watery in storage.

recipes.name: Vietnamese prawn spiralized rolls
steps: Mix the dipping sauce ingredients with 50ml water; set aside to dissolve.
Soften a rice paper wrapper in warm water on a damp tea towel.
Add mint, coriander, two prawns and spiralized veg to the wrapper.
Fold the sides and edges over the filling and roll tightly; serve sliced with the sauce.

batch.notes: Best eaten by day 3; freeze later portions.

recipes.name: Vietnamese veg parcels
steps: Soak the rice pancakes and noodles per pack; drain and cut the noodles into strips.
Lay noodles, chicken, vegetables and herbs a third up a pancake, leaving a 1cm edge.
Fold the sides in and roll up lengthways into a cigar.
Chill up to 1 day; serve with dipping sauce, leaves and herbs.

batch.notes: Add the cucumber fresh; it turns watery in storage.

recipes.name: Vietnamese-style caramel pork
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok and stir-fry the pork in batches until browned; set aside.
Soften shallots, ginger and chilli, then add sugar, fish sauce and 200ml water; boil.
Return the pork and bubble 8-10 min until the sauce thickens and turns glossy.
Stir in extra fish and chilli sauce, sprinkle spring onions; serve with rice and pak choi.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Vietnamese-style veggie hotpot
steps: Heat oil, add ginger and garlic and stir-fry ~5 min.
Add squash, soy sauce, sugar and stock; cover and simmer 10 min.
Add the green beans and cook 3 min more until tender.
Stir through spring onions, sprinkle with coriander and serve with rice.

batch.notes: Cool the rice fast in shallow pans; reheat to 165 °F.

recipes.name: Warm roast asparagus salad
steps: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C; arrange trimmed asparagus and halved tomatoes in a tray, oil and season.
Roll the bacon rashers, add to the tray, drizzle with honey and bake 20 minutes.
Boil the potatoes until tender; whisk vinegar, oil, mustard and seasoning into a dressing.
Toss rocket in half the dressing and arrange on a platter.
Halve the potatoes, toss in remaining dressing and plate with asparagus, tomatoes and bacon.

batch.notes: Keep greens and dressing apart; assemble the day you eat it.

recipes.name: Wontons
steps: Combine pork, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil and vegetables in a bowl.
Place a heaping teaspoon of filling in the centre of each wonton skin.
Brush water on two edges, fold into a triangle and seal, then pinch the long points together.
Heat oil to 450F and fry 4-5 at a time until golden.
Drain and serve with dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Yaki Udon
steps: Boil water with 250ml cold water and the udon; cook 2 mins (fresh) or 5-6 mins (dried), then drain.
Heat 1 tbsp oil and saute onion and cabbage 5 minutes until softened.
Add mushrooms and some spring onions and saute 1 minute more.
Add remaining sesame oil, the noodles and sauce ingredients; stir-fry until sticky and piping hot.
Sprinkle with the remaining spring onions to serve.

recipes.name: Yemeni Lahsa (Elite Shakshuka)
steps: Heat olive oil over medium heat and cook the diced onion until it softens.
Add the tomatoes and cook 4-5 minutes, then season with allspice, salt and pepper.
Add the eggs, mix 2 minutes, then cover and cook 5-6 minutes until the top sets.
Spread over the liquid cheese and cover 1 minute to melt.
Serve Mediterranean-style with sides such as beans, olives and feta.

batch.notes: Reheat to 165 °F; eggs turn rubbery if frozen.

recipes.name: Yorkshire Puddings
steps: Heat oven to 230C/fan 210C and drizzle sunflower oil into two Yorkshire pudding or muffin tins.
Heat the tins in the oven while you make the batter.
Beat 140g flour with 4 eggs until smooth, then whisk in 200ml milk and season.
Pour the batter into the hot tins and return to the oven.
Bake undisturbed 20-25 minutes until puffed and browned; serve immediately.

recipes.name: Zapiekanki
steps: Heat oven to 200C/fan 180C; bake the baguettes 8-10 minutes, then cool.
Cook onion in butter and oil, add mushrooms until liquid evaporates, then garlic; stir in mayonnaise.
Halve baguettes lengthways, spread with the mushroom mix, top with cheddar, ham, kabanos and mozzarella.
Bake 8-10 minutes until the cheese is golden and melted.
Fry sliced onions until caramelised; top with onions, pickles, chives and ketchup.

batch.notes: Keep cold; mayonnaise dressings separate if frozen.

recipes.name: Zemiakové Placky
steps: Peel and finely grate the potatoes, then squeeze out as much moisture as possible.
Mix the potatoes with onion, garlic, eggs, flour, marjoram, salt and pepper into a thick batter.
Heat a generous amount of oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Spoon in the batter, flatten into thin pancakes and fry until golden and crispy on both sides.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with sour cream or garlic dip.
